news.body_en: Chelsea Under-18s are back in Under-18 Premier League action as they prepare for a London derby at Cobham. The Blues face Arsenal at home and CFC+ subscribers can watch the game live on the Chelsea Official App and website. Before the international break, we progressed to the last eight of the U18 PL Cup following a 3-1 win over Charlton Athletic, as Jashayde Greenwood netted either side of Andrew Pennie’s thumping finish. We will now be looking to get back to winning ways in the league after falling short against West Ham at the end of October. Here is how you can watch the Under-18 Premier League match against Arsenal live… The game kicks off at the Cobham Training Ground at 11am (UK time) on Saturday 21 November. All CFC+ subscribers can watch this match, and all of Chelsea’s Under-18 fixtures this season, live on the official Chelsea website and the Chelsea Official App. You can get more details on CFC+ and sign up here. You can watch the live stream in our Chelsea Under-18s vs Arsenal Match Centre by clicking below or via the homepage of the official Chelsea website and Chelsea Official App shortly before kick-off. Ensure that you are logged in with your CFC+ subscription to view the stream. Highlights of the match will be available for free to all supporters on the Chelsea Official App and website on the morning of Sunday 22 November.

news.title: Chelsea vs Leeds: Key statistics and facts
news.title_zh: 切尔西 vs 利兹联：关键统计数据和事实
news.body_en: Chelsea host old rivals Leeds United at Stamford Bridge on Saturday as the busy run of winter fixtures gets underway. Here are all the key facts and figures you need ahead of kick-off. The Premier League resumes this weekend after the international break with Chelsea in fifth position, two points behind Liverpool in fourth. Leeds, in ninth place, go into Matchweek 11 two points off fifth place and six from the relegation zone. Leeds United return to Stamford Bridge for the second time in 10 weeks, following our 6-3 Carabao Cup win in September. This is the 99th league meeting between Chelsea and Leeds. Chelsea are unbeaten at Stamford Bridge against Leeds United in 10 games in all competitions, winning eight and drawing two. Leeds' last win at the Bridge was in December 1999, in the Premier League, when a 2-0 victory put them top of the Premier League. The Blues finished the game with 10 men, after Frank Leboeuf was sent off on 68 minutes. Leeds did not lose either Premier League game against Chelsea last season. The last time they went three meetings unbeaten against the Blues was between November 2000 and October 2001. In last season’s corresponding game at Stamford Bridge, Joao Pedro and a Cole Palmer penalty gave the Blues a two-goal lead, but second-half strikes from Lukas Nmecha and Noah Okafor earned Leeds a draw. It was the first time they had avoided defeat at the Bridge since November 2000. Chelsea have won 10 points from five Premier League home games this season, our most after five home matches at the start of a campaign under a new manager since 2018/19, under Maurizio Sarri (11). Palmer and Morgan Rogers are the only Chelsea players to have started every Premier League game this season. Chelsea have the highest shot accuracy in the Premier League this season (41.9 per cent). In the six games in league and cup between the last two international breaks, Chelsea conceded just one goal from open play, plus two penalties and two from corners. news.title: Sjoeke Nusken: There is more to come from us
news.title_zh: Sjoeke Nusken：我们还有更多要做的事情
news.body_en: Sjoeke Nusken believes Chelsea have another level to reach despite reclaiming top spot in the Women's Super League, with the midfielder determined to build on our impressive victory over Manchester City when we face Liverpool on Saturday. The Blues moved a point clear at the summit following last weekend's 1-0 triumph at Stamford Bridge, with Sandy Baltimore's brilliant strike securing an important victory over our title rivals. But while Nusken was delighted with the result, the German international believes there is still plenty of room for improvement in Sonia Bompastor's side. 'We have so much quality in our group,' said Nusken. 'We're still not on our best level. Especially in the final third, we can improve a little more, with the crossing and finishing. But it's getting better and better every single time when we're playing together, and I think you can see it. It's still a process, so we keep going.' The midfielder also insists our approach will not change now that Chelsea are the team being chased. 'We need to win every other game, otherwise it didn't help us to win against Man City. We need to win against everyone. 'We have the Champions League as well. We have a lot of games and it's important to go from game to game.' Our next league challenge comes against Liverpool at St Helens Stadium on Saturday, and Nusken is anticipating another demanding encounter. 'Liverpool are a really good team, and it's always an intense game against them. The last couple of years it was always a tight game, and they have a lot of new good signings as well. 'We need to put our best performance on the pitch like in the last game. We need to stay strong defensively to not concede anything and hopefully score more goals up front.' Now in her fourth season at Chelsea, Nusken believes the togetherness within Bompastor's squad has been important in navigating a demanding schedule. 'We're spending so much time together and it's so much more fun when we're enjoying our time here. 'We're checking in with each other, we're asking how we are and doing a lot of things off the pitch as well, so it's really nice.' The 25-year-old has also reflected on her own development since moving to England in 2023, having grown in confidence and taken on greater responsibility. 'On the field, I think I can learn a lot from different players here. I play with so many players, different types of styles, and it's so nice to have them around me and to improve every single day. 'But I have the feeling that I'm still not finished yet. I know how far I can go, and I think there's a lot more to come.' With the Women's World Cup approaching next summer and Chelsea competing for silverware on several fronts, Nusken is determined to keep progressing. 'We have so many things we can win. We have so much talent in our squad, and I think if we can still improve, working on the small details, we have a big future ahead. 'And yeah, one trophy is still missing, and of course this is the big aim for our season.'
news.body_zh: 舍克·努斯肯相信，尽管切尔西重新夺回了女足超级联赛的榜首位置，但她还需要达到另一个水平，这位中场球员决心在周六对阵利物浦时，在我们对曼城的令人印象深刻的胜利的基础上再接再厉。上周末在斯坦福桥 1-0 获胜后，蓝军在积分榜上领先一分，桑迪·巴尔的摩的精彩进球确保了对冠军对手的重要胜利。尽管努斯肯对结果感到高兴，但这位德国国脚相信索尼娅·邦帕斯托的球队仍有很大的改进空间。 “我们团队的素质非常高，”努斯肯说。 “我们还没有达到最佳水平。尤其是在最后三分之一，我们可以通过传中和射门进一步提高。但每次我们一起比赛时，情况都变得越来越好，我想你可以看到这一点。这仍然是一个过程，所以我们会继续前进。”这位中场球员还坚称，既然切尔西是被追赶的球队，我们的做法就不会改变。 “我们需要赢得所有其他比赛，否则这对我们战胜曼城没有帮助。我们需要战胜所有人。 “我们还有欧冠联赛。我们有很多比赛，从一场比赛到另一场比赛很重要。”我们的下一场联赛挑战将于周六在圣海伦斯体育场对阵利物浦，努斯肯期待着另一场艰苦的比赛。 “利物浦是一支非常优秀的球队，对阵他们总是一场激烈的比赛。过去几年，比赛总是很紧张，他们也签下了很多新的优秀球员。 “我们需要像上一场比赛一样在球场上发挥出最好的表现。我们需要保持坚强的防守，不丢球，希望能在前面取得更多进球。”现在是她在切尔西的第四个赛季，努斯肯相信邦帕斯托队内的团结对于应对艰巨的赛程非常重要。 “我们在一起度过了很多时间，当我们在这里享受时光时，会变得更加有趣。 “我们会互相检查，询问我们的情况，并在场外做很多事情，所以这真的很好。”这位 25 岁的球员还反思了自 2023 年移居英格兰以来自己的发展，自信增强并承担了更大的责任。 “在球场上，我认为我可以从不同的球员身上学到很多东西。我和很多不同风格的球员一起比赛，很高兴有他们在我身边，每天都在进步。 “但我有一种感觉，我还没有完成。我知道我能走多远，而且我认为还有更多的事情要做。随着明年夏天女足世界杯的临近，切尔西在多条战线上争夺奖杯，努斯肯决心继续前进。 “我们有很多东西可以赢得。我们队里有很多才华横溢的人，我认为如果我们仍然能够进步，在小细节上努力，我们就会有一个光明的未来。 “是的，仍然缺少一座奖杯，当然这是我们赛季的大目标。”

news.title: Donation points for That's Proper Chels campaign to continue at Saturday’s match
news.title_zh: “That's Proper Chels”活动的捐赠积分将在周六的比赛中继续进行
news.body_en: The next opportunity for fans to donate gifts to our 2026 festive campaign is the Premier League match against Leeds at Stamford Bridge this weekend. Chelsea Football Club, Chelsea FC Women and Chelsea Foundation have joined forces for a third consecutive year to support our local community and make a positive difference this festive season. Alongside a percentage of festive range sales being donated to Chelsea Foundation, we are inviting supporters to help make Christmas a little brighter for people in our local communities. We welcome donations of new, unwrapped gifts for both older people and children or young people. Suggested gifts include: Blankets and warm or grip slipper socks Craft kits, puzzles and crossword books Photo albums, notebooks, diaries and calendars Gift donation points, organised in association with the Chelsea Supporters' Trust, will be available at Britannia Gate at every home match between now and 21 December, giving supporters the opportunity to drop off a gift when they visit Stamford Bridge. Donation points will be open two hours before kick-off. Every gift donated will help bring extra joy and connection to someone who may otherwise be facing Christmas feeling lonely or isolated. If you are unable to bring a gift, you can also donate £5 by texting CFCFOUNDATION to 70085. Click here if you would like to donate more than £5 Thank you for helping us make a difference in our community and for showing what it means to be ‘Proper Chels’. Click for more on the That's Proper Chels campaign
news.body_zh: 球迷为 2026 年节日活动捐赠礼物的下一个机会是本周末在斯坦福桥对阵利兹联的英超比赛。切尔西足球俱乐部、切尔西女足和切尔西基金会连续第三年联手支持当地社区，并在这个节日做出积极的改变。除了将节日系列销售额的一部分捐赠给切尔西基金会外，我们还邀请支持者帮助当地社区的人们过上更加美好的圣诞节。我们欢迎为老年人、儿童或年轻人捐赠新的、未包装的礼物。建议的礼物包括： 毯子和保暖或防滑的拖鞋袜 手工工具包、拼图和填字游戏 相册、笔记本、日记和日历 与切尔西支持者信托基金会联合组织的礼物捐赠点将从现在到 12 月 21 日期间在每场主场比赛的不列颠尼亚门提供，让支持者在访问斯坦福桥时有机会赠送礼物。捐赠点将于开球前两小时开放。捐赠的每一份礼物都将为那些可能在圣诞节感到孤独或孤立的人带来额外的快乐和联系。如果您无法携带礼物，您也可以通过发送短信 CFCFOUNDATION 至 70085 来捐赠 5 英镑。如果您想捐赠超过 5 英镑，请点击此处。感谢您帮助我们为我们的社区做出贡献，并展示了“Proper Chels”的含义。点击了解有关 That's Proper Chels 活动的更多信息

news.title: Andrew Pennie signs first professional contract
news.title_zh: 安德鲁·彭尼签署第一份职业合同
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club is pleased to announce that Academy forward Andrew Pennie has signed his first professional contract with the Blues. Pennie joined Chelsea aged eight and has developed into an explosive forward with a natural eye for goal. The 17-year-old has already scored 14 goals this season across all competitions for the Under-17s and Under-18s. Last season, while still a schoolboy, Pennie featured for the Under-18s and scored vital goals against Birmingham City and West Ham United, including a stunning strike in a 3-1 victory over Birmingham at Cobham. He also made his Chelsea Cobham Next Gen debut in October 2025 when he was just 15 years old, appearing in the EFL Trophy against Walsall. He has signed the professional deal following his 17th birthday, having signed a scholarship contract back in July 2026.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部很高兴地宣布青训前锋安德鲁·佩尼与蓝军签署了他的第一份职业合同。佩尼八岁时加入切尔西，现已发展成为一名具有天生进球眼光的爆发力前锋。这位17岁的球员本赛季已经在U-17和U-18的所有比赛中打进了14个进球。上个赛季，还在上学的彭尼就代表 18 岁以下青年队出场，在对阵伯明翰城和西汉姆联队的比赛中打进了至关重要的进球，其中包括在科巴姆 3-1 战胜伯明翰队的比赛中打进的惊人进球。 2025 年 10 月，年仅 15 岁的他还首次代表切尔西科巴姆下一代队亮相，参加了对阵沃尔索尔的 EFL 杯比赛。他在 17 岁生日后签署了这份职业合同，并于 2026 年 7 月签署了一份奖学金合同。

news.title: Chelsea FC joins with Zara to launch kidswear collection
news.title_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部与 Zara 合作推出童装系列
news.body_en: In a Chelsea Football Club first, we have linked up with international high-street fashion retailer Zara to create a new opportunity for fans seeking club-branded kidswear, bags and fragrance. This new Chelsea collection launches today and is available in 1,200 Zara stores globally, making it easily accessible as part of the everyday shopping experience, and also from Zara’s online store. The kidswear range is extensive – with the colour selection including white, black, grey and of course, blue items – all with the Chelsea name and badge proudly displayed. There are kids’ sizes covering 18 months to five years old, and boys’ sizes from six to 14 years old, ensuring Chelsea-inspired style is accessible to families at every stage. As can be seen here today and explored now on the high street, there are hoodies, jackets and joggers, plus t-shirts for when those warmer days return or your kids’ activities demand. There are two choices for anything that needs to be carried - a backpack and a belt bag -both ideal for school and more. Teaming up with Zara means we also have something for our older supporters - with a Chelsea eau de toilette fragrance unveiled. The Chelsea FC x Zara Kids collection, available now at zara.com and selected Zara stores worldwide, combines Chelsea's iconic identity with Zara's contemporary childrenswear design, creating a range that celebrates football culture while fitting seamlessly into young fans' everyday wardrobes.
news.body_zh: 在切尔西足球俱乐部，我们首先与国际高街时装零售商 Zara 合作，为寻求俱乐部品牌童装、箱包和香水的球迷创造了新的机会。这个全新的 Chelsea 系列于今天推出，并在全球 1,200 家 Zara 门店有售，使其成为日常购物体验的一部分，也可以从 Zara 的在线商店轻松购买。童装系列非常丰富——颜色选择包括白色、黑色、灰色，当然还有蓝色——所有产品都自豪地展示着切尔西的名字和徽章。儿童尺码涵盖 18 个月至 5 岁，男孩尺码涵盖 6 至 14 岁，确保每个阶段的家庭都能享受切尔西风格的风格。正如今天在这里和大街上所看到的，这里有连帽衫、夹克和慢跑裤，还有 T 恤，适合回暖的日子或您孩子的活动需要时使用。对于需要携带的任何物品，有两种选择 - 背包和腰包 - 都是上学和其他场合的理想选择。与 Zara 合作意味着我们还为我们的老支持者提供了一些东西 - 推出了切尔西淡香水。切尔西足球俱乐部 x Zara 儿童系列现已在 zara.com 和全球精选 Zara 专卖店发售，将切尔西的标志性形象与 Zara 的当代童装设计相结合，打造出一个颂扬足球文化的系列，同时无缝融入年轻球迷的日常衣柜。

news.title: Liverpool vs Chelsea Women: How to watch, kick-off time, live stream info
news.title_zh: 利物浦 vs 切尔西女足：如何观看、开球时间、直播信息
news.body_en: Chelsea Women head to Liverpool on Saturday looking to maintain our position at the top of the Women's Super League following last weekend's vital victory over Manchester City. The Blues moved one point clear in first place after Sandy Baltimore's stunning strike secured a 1-0 win at Stamford Bridge, extending our unbeaten start to the league campaign. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Liverpool against Chelsea Women, including the kick-off time and how to follow the action on our official channels. Chelsea Women's game against Liverpool takes place on Saturday 21 November at St Helens Stadium, with kick-off scheduled for 12.45pm UK time. The match will be shown live in the UK on Sky Sports. As always, team news, live updates and match coverage will be provided in our Chelsea Women vs Everton Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and Chelsea website. You can also follow along via Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. Chelsea remain unbeaten in the WSL this season, having won eight and drawn two of our opening 10 matches. Sonia Bompastor's side have scored 29 league goals and conceded just five, with Saturday's victory over Manchester City moving us onto 26 points. Liverpool head into the contest having returned to winning ways with an impressive 3-0 victory away to Brighton & Hove Albion last weekend. Beata Olsson scored twice and Cornelia Kapocs was also on target as the Reds ended a five-match winless run in the league. Chelsea took four points from our two WSL meetings with Liverpool last season. Alyssa Thompson's superb early strike earned us a 1-1 draw at St Helens Stadium in November, before goals from Sjoeke Nusken and Lauren James secured a 2-0 victory at Kingsmeadow in February. We also faced the Reds in the Women's League Cup quarter-finals in December, producing a stunning attacking display to win 9-1 away from home and reach the last four. It was the first time a team had scored nine goals in a knockout tie in the competition's history. The Blues are unbeaten in our last six meetings with Liverpool across all competitions, winning five and drawing one, since a 4-3 WSL defeat at Prenton Park in May 2024. Our last WSL victory at St Helens came in November 2024, when goals from Mayra Ramirez, Guro Reiten and Aggie Beever-Jones secured a 3-0 win.
news.body_zh: 继上周末战胜曼城之后，切尔西女足将于周六前往利物浦，希望保持女足超级联赛榜首的位置。桑迪·巴尔的摩 (Sandy Baltimore) 的精彩进球帮助蓝军在斯坦福桥 (Stamford Bridge) 1-0 获胜，从而将联赛不败的开局延续到了第一名。以下是您需要了解的有关如何观看利物浦对阵切尔西女足的所有信息，包括开球时间以及如何关注我们官方频道的比赛。切尔西女足对阵利物浦的比赛将于 11 月 21 日星期六在圣海伦斯体育场举行，开球时间定于英国时间中午 12 点 45 分。这场比赛将在英国天空体育直播。与往常一样，球队新闻、实时更新和比赛报道将在切尔西官方应用程序和切尔西网站上的切尔西女足对阵埃弗顿比赛中心提供。您还可以通过 X、Facebook、Instagram 和 TikTok 上的 Chelsea Women 社交媒体渠道进行关注。切尔西本赛季在 WSL 中保持不败，在开局 10 场比赛中取得 8 胜 2 平。索尼娅·邦帕斯托的球队已经打进 29 个联赛进球，只丢了 5 个进球，周六战胜曼城的比赛让我们的积分上升到了 26 分。利物浦上周末客场3-0战胜布莱顿，重回胜利之路，进入欧冠联赛。贝塔·奥尔森梅开二度，科妮莉亚·卡波克斯也进球，帮助红军结束了联赛五场不胜的局面。切尔西在上赛季与利物浦的两场 WSL 比赛中拿下 4 分。 11 月，艾莉莎·汤普森 (Alyssa Thompson) 的精彩进球为我们在圣海伦斯体育场 (St Helens Stadium) 赢得了 1-1 平局，而 2 月，Sjoeke Nusken 和劳伦·詹姆斯 (Lauren James) 的进球帮助我们在 Kingsmeadow 2-0 获胜。 12月，我们还在女足联赛杯四分之一决赛中对阵红军，凭借出色的进攻表现，客场9-1获胜，晋级四强。这是赛事历史上第一次有球队在淘汰赛中打进九球。自 2024 年 5 月在普伦顿公园以 4-3 击败 WSL 以来，蓝军在过去六次与利物浦交锋中保持不败，取得了 5 胜 1 平的成绩。我们上一次在圣海伦斯取得 WSL 胜利是在 2024 年 11 月，当时迈拉·拉米雷斯、古罗·雷滕和阿吉·比弗-琼斯的进球确保了 3-0 的胜利。

news.title: Bompastor: Buurman is a 'complete player and a top talent'
news.title_zh: Bompastor：布尔曼是一名“全面的球员和顶尖的天才”
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has praised Veerle Buurman's maturity and development after the young defender scored the winning goal in Chelsea's 1-0 UEFA Women's Champions League victory over Paris Saint-Germain. The Dutch international struck in the 87th minute at Plough Lane, reacting quickest inside the penalty area to secure three valuable points and extend our impressive defensive record in Europe. It was another outstanding performance from the 20-year-old, who has continued to establish herself as an important member of Bompastor's squad. 'Veerle has been performing at a really good level since January this year,' said our head coach. 'She's a top talent. She's very mature, both on and off the pitch. She reads the game well, understands the game and is really smart.' Buurman was instrumental in keeping PSG at bay, demonstrating excellent defensive awareness when the visitors threatened on the counter-attack. And Bompastor believes her impressive physical attributes, combined with her composure in possession, make her a very well-rounded defender. 'She's strong and has a lot of speed to recover the space in behind. She's strong in duels, particularly aerial duels, and wins the first contact most of the time. 'She's also really confident with the ball and brings a lot of quality to the team. Her ability on the ball helps her play with that confidence.' Despite her impressive development, Bompastor believes there is still room for Buurman to improve, particularly when it comes to maintaining such high standards consistently. 'She's a really complete player and a top talent. She's helping the team perform at a really good level right now. 'But she's still young, and we sometimes have conversations about how she can remain as consistent as possible and maintain this level of performance for as long as possible.' With another assured defensive display and a decisive goal to her name, Buurman definitely showed her growing importance to the Blues.
news.body_zh: 在切尔西 1-0 战胜巴黎圣日耳曼的欧冠女足联赛中，年轻后卫维尔勒·布尔曼 (Veerle Buurman) 攻入制胜一球后，索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 赞扬了维尔勒·布尔曼 (Veerle Buurman) 的成熟和发展。这位荷兰国脚在第 87 分钟在普劳巷射门，在禁区内反应最快，获得了宝贵的三分，并延续了我们在欧洲令人印象深刻的防守记录。这是这位 20 岁球员的又一次出色表现，她继续将自己确立为邦帕斯托队的重要成员。 “自今年一月以来，维尔勒的表现一直非常好，”我们的主教练说道。 ‘她是一位顶尖的人才。无论是在场上还是场下，她都非常成熟。她很好地阅读了比赛，理解了比赛，而且非常聪明。”布尔曼在阻止巴黎圣日耳曼的进攻中发挥了重要作用，当客队发起反击时，他展示了出色的防守意识。邦帕斯托相信她令人印象深刻的身体素质，加上控球时的冷静，使她成为一名非常全面的后卫。 “她很强壮，速度很快，可以收回后面的空间。她在决斗中表现出色，尤其是空中决斗，并且大多数时候都能在第一次接触中获胜。 “她对球也非常有信心，为球队带来了很多力量。她的控球能力帮助她充满自信地打球。尽管取得了令人印象深刻的发展，邦帕斯特认为布尔曼仍有改进的空间，特别是在始终如一地保持如此高的标准方面。 “她是一位非常全面的球员，也是一位顶尖的天才。她现在正在帮助球队发挥出非常好的水平。 “但她还很年轻，我们有时会讨论她如何尽可能保持稳定并尽可能长时间地保持这种表现水平。”凭借又一次可靠的防守表现和决定性的进球，布尔曼无疑表明了她对蓝军日益增长的重要性。

news.title: Two January fixtures moved for TV coverage
news.title_zh: 一月份的两场比赛已移至电视转播位置
news.body_en: A further two of Chelsea’s Premier League fixtures during January have been selected for live television broadcast and now have new dates or kick-off times. Our first two league games of 2027, at home against Newcastle United and away at Crystal Palace, had already been confirmed for live broadcast, and another two have now joined them. That includes the return fixture of our upcoming game against Leeds United. When we travel to Elland Road in the new year, the match will now take place two days later on Monday 25 January, with kick-off at 8pm. The following game, when we end January by hosting Nottingham Forest at Stamford Bridge, remains scheduled for Saturday 30 January, but will now start at the later time of 5.30pm. All four of our televised games in January will be broadcast live by Sky Sports in the UK. Our January schedule will be completed by the start of our FA Cup campaign, with third-round ties in that competition due to take place across the weekend of 9 January. Ticket information for all the Blues’ January fixtures will be released in due course. Club Chelsea packages, where you can experience the action from premium seats, complemented by exceptional hospitality before and after the match, are on sale now. Chelsea vs Newcastle United – Sunday 3 January, 2pmCrystal Palace vs Chelsea – Wednesday 6 January, 7.30pmChelsea vs Sunderland – Saturday 16 January, 3pmLeeds United vs Chelsea – Monday 25 January, 8pmChelsea vs Nottingham Forest – Saturday 30 January, 5.30pm

news.title: Buurman praises Chelsea's determination after late win
news.title_zh: 布尔曼赞扬切尔西在最后时刻获胜后的决心
news.body_en: Veerle Buurman hailed Chelsea's determination after scoring a dramatic late winner against Paris Saint-Germain, with the defender also highlighting our defensive strength and the importance of securing a top-four finish in the UEFA Women's Champions League. The Dutch youngster struck in the 87th minute at Plough Lane, turning home from close range following a corner to secure a hard-fought 1-0 victory and three valuable points. It was another memorable evening for Buurman, who was named Player of the Match for the second consecutive game after also receiving the award following Saturday's victory over Manchester City. 'Of course, it's really nice to score a goal. It's a really important three points. We fought until the end with the team, and to score the winning goal is of course something to be really proud of,' said Buurman. 'I think Lucy touched it first and then I just turned and tried to shoot!' The victory was particularly welcome following our goalless draw with Hacken last time out in Europe, with Buurman explaining how the Blues remained patient against a stubborn PSG defence. 'They went deeper so we had to play a lot out wide, there was a lot of space. In the second half, we switched the formation a little bit and we did really well with a lot of crosses. 'Corners as well, we are training a lot on them, and I'm happy to score one.' Equally pleasing for Buurman was another clean sheet, our fifth in the Champions League this season, as Chelsea continued to demonstrate impressive resilience. 'Overall as a team we're doing really well in defending. A clean sheet is really important for us as a backline. It's maybe one of the nicest things if you keep a clean sheet. 'I think it started in pre-season, how we want to defend, what we expect from the midfielders in front of us, tracking the runs.' The 20-year-old has continued to develop alongside experienced defenders including Lucy Bronze, Nathalie Bjorn and Katie McCabe, whose influence she believes has been invaluable. 'I'm learning a lot from them with their experience, but to be part of the group and learning every day and every game means a lot. 'As a defender, I really like defending, and I think if you have a backline and play next to Lucy, Katie, Nat, it's amazing to play next to so much experience.' And with Chelsea now occupying a top-four position in the league phase, Buurman is determined to secure automatic qualification for the quarter-finals and avoid the additional knockout play-off round. 'We have to focus on finishing in the top four in the Champions League. That's really important. 'You miss a round (qualifying automatically), so that will be really nice. I think that's our main objective.'
news.body_zh: 维尔勒·布尔曼赞扬了切尔西在对阵巴黎圣日耳曼队的比赛中最后时刻戏剧性的制胜球后的决心，这名后卫还强调了我们的防守实力以及确保在欧洲女子冠军联赛中进入前四的重要性。这位荷兰小将在第87分钟在普劳巷球场攻入一球，接角球后近距离破门破门，帮助球队1-0艰难获胜并获得宝贵的三分。对于布尔曼来说，这是另一个难忘的夜晚，他在周六战胜曼城后也获得了该奖项，连续第二场比赛被评为全场最佳球员。 “当然，进球真的很高兴。这是非常重要的三点。我们和球队一起战斗到了最后，能够打进制胜球当然是一件值得骄傲的事情。”布尔曼说道。 “我认为露西先触碰了它，然后我就转身尝试射击！”继上次在欧洲比赛中我们0-0战平哈肯之后，这场胜利尤其值得欢迎，布尔曼解释了蓝军如何在巴黎圣日耳曼顽强的防守中保持耐心。 “他们走得更深，所以我们必须在边路打很多球，那里有很多空间。下半场我们稍微改变了阵型，并且通过很多传中做得非常好。 “角球也是如此，我们在角球上进行了大量训练，我很高兴能打进一球。”同样令布尔曼高兴的是另一场不失球，这是我们本赛季在欧冠联赛中第五次零失球，切尔西继续展现出令人印象深刻的韧性。 “总的来说，作为一支球队，我们在防守方面做得非常好。作为后防线，一场零失球对于我们来说非常重要。如果你保持零失球，这可能是最好的事情之一。 “我认为这一切从季前赛开始，我们想如何防守，我们对前面的中场球员有什么期望，跟踪跑动。”这位 20 岁的球员与露西·青铜 (Lucy Bronze)、纳塔莉·比约恩 (Nathalie Bjorn) 和凯蒂·麦凯布 (Katie McCabe) 等经验丰富的后卫一起不断成长，她认为他们的影响力是无价的。 “我从他们的经验中学到了很多，但成为团队的一员，每天、每场比赛都学习意味着很多。 “作为一名后卫，我真的很喜欢防守，我认为如果你有后防线并在露西、凯蒂、纳特旁边比赛，那么在如此丰富的经验旁边比赛真是太棒了。”由于切尔西目前在联赛阶段占据前四的位置，布尔曼决心确保自动晋级四分之一决赛，并避免额外的淘汰赛。 “我们必须集中精力进入欧冠前四。这真的很重要。 “你错过了一轮比赛（自动晋级），所以这真的很好。我认为这是我们的主要目标。

news.title: Defender voted Star of the Match against PSG!
news.title_zh: 后卫被评为对阵巴黎圣日耳曼的比赛之星！
news.body_en: Chelsea Women secured a narrow Champions League victory over Paris Saint-Germain on Wednesday evening, and Blues fans have now voted for their Star of the Match. A hard-fought game of few clear chances at either end was decided late on by Veerle Buurman, who bundled the ball in from close range after an Erin Cuthbert corner caused chaos in the Paris defence. The 1-0 victory means we are still yet to concede in this season’s Champions League, and currently sit top of the the league phase table ahead of Thursday evening’s action. And it was the matchwinner Buurman who you chose as your Star of the Match for the second game running. Not only did she score the winning goal, but Buurman helped build our attacks from the back with some incisive passing, and was rock solid once again in snuffing out the opposition’s threat. She received a huge 74 per cent of the votes cast, with former PSG player Sandy Baltimore way behind in second with nine per cent.
news.body_zh: 周三晚上，切尔西女足在欧冠联赛中险胜巴黎圣日耳曼队，蓝军球迷现在已经投票选出了她们的比赛之星。这场激烈的比赛双方都没有明显的机会，最后由维尔勒·布尔曼决定胜负，在艾琳·卡斯伯特的角球造成巴黎防线混乱后，他近距离将球打进。 1-0的胜利意味着我们在本赛季的冠军联赛中尚未失球，并且在周四晚上的比赛之前目前在联赛阶段表上排名第一。您连续第二场比赛选择了比赛获胜者布尔曼作为您的比赛之星。她不仅打进了制胜一球，布尔曼还通过一些犀利的传球帮助我们从后场发起进攻，并再次以坚如磐石的方式消除了对手的威胁。她获得了 74% 的选票，前巴黎圣日耳曼球员桑迪·巴尔的摩以 9% 的得票率位居第二。

news.title: Ibrahim Rabbaj named in Morocco squad for Under-17 World Cup
news.title_zh: 易卜拉欣·拉巴伊入选摩洛哥 17 岁以下世界杯大名单
news.body_en: Ibrahim Rabbaj has been selected in Morocco's squad for the FIFA Under-17 World Cup, with the Chelsea forward set to represent his country at the tournament in Qatar. The 17-year-old is one of 21 players included by Morocco head coach Ahmed Kantari for the competition, which gets underway today. Rabbaj heads into the tournament after an impressive season at academy level, having made an impact for both the Under-18s and Cobham Next Gen sides. His selection continues a strong tradition of Chelsea youngsters competing on the international stage. Morocco have been drawn in Group H, alongside Fiji, Morocco and Spain. Their campaign begins against Fiji on Friday 20 November. This year's Under-17 World Cup features 48 nations from across the globe competing for the title. The tournament will run until December 13, with the final taking place at Ahmad bin Ali Stadium. Portugal are the holders, with Morocco having reached the quarter-finals in each of the past two editions. We will keep you updated as to how Rabbaj and Morocco get on throughout the tournament. Morocco vs Fiji – Friday 20 November, 4pm Morocco vs China – Monday 23 November, 3pm Morocco vs Spain – Thursday 26 November, 3pm
news.body_zh: 易卜拉欣·拉巴伊 (Ibrahim Rabbaj) 已入选摩洛哥参加 FIFA 17 岁以下世界杯的阵容，这位切尔西前锋将代表摩洛哥参加在卡塔尔举行的锦标赛。这位 17 岁的球员是摩洛哥主教练艾哈迈德·坎塔里挑选的 21 名球员之一，比赛将于今天开始。拉巴杰在学院级别度过了令人印象深刻的赛季后，进入了锦标赛，为 18 岁以下球队和科巴姆下一代球队带来了影响。他的入选延续了切尔西年轻球员在国际舞台上竞争的优良传统。摩洛哥被分在H组，与斐济、摩洛哥和西班牙同组。他们的比赛将于 11 月 20 日星期五对阵斐济。今年的 17 岁以下世界杯有来自全球 48 个国家的选手争夺冠军头衔。比赛将持续到12月13日，决赛将在艾哈迈德·本·阿里体育场举行。葡萄牙队是卫冕冠军，而摩洛哥队在过去两届比赛中都进入了四分之一决赛。我们将随时向您通报拉巴伊和摩洛哥队在整个锦标赛中的表现。摩洛哥 vs 斐济 – 11 月 20 日星期五下午 4 点 摩洛哥 vs 中国 – 11 月 23 日星期一下午 3 点 摩洛哥 vs 西班牙 – 11 月 26 日星期四下午 3 点

news.title: Henderson details how Blues are working to build the 'best version of ourselves'
news.title_zh: 亨德森详细介绍了蓝军如何努力打造“最好的自己”
news.body_en: Jordan Henderson says he and the other Chelsea players who remained at Cobham during the international break have been working hard to build the rhythm needed to compete at our best in every Premier League fixture. While several members of the Blues squad have been away representing their countries over the past ten days, Henderson is one of those who remained at our training base to work with Xabi Alonso. Before this pause in the domestic calendar, Henderson and his fellow Blues recorded a run of three wins from four Premier League fixtures. But we went into the break on a disappointing note, with Alonso's side suffering a 1-0 defeat at Sunderland. We return to Premier League action this weekend by hosting Leeds United at Stamford Bridge on Saturday. The fixture begins a busy run over winter, during which the Blues are hoping to put our inconsistencies behind us to mount a sustained assault on the top four. ‘I think there’ve been some good things, but things that we can improve on, of course,’ said Henderson, using this pause to reflect on the 2026/27 season so far. ‘A little bit of inconsistency, but that's what we're trying to get better and improve on, trying to be more consistent every day, in training and obviously in the games, to get the best performances that we can achieve as a team and be the best version of ourselves. ‘So we'll continue to work and hopefully throughout the course of the season, and the longer the season goes on, we can find more consistency and more rhythm with our performances. ‘The important thing is not looking too far ahead. There's a long way to go in the season, a lot of points, a lot of games to play. So it's just about focusing on the next one at the minute. ‘I think we've shown some good things, but things that we need to improve on. So it's about taking it game by game, showing that we can compete in every single game and ensure that consistency. When we do that, then the results will take care of themselves.’ The 36-year-old is likely to play an important role in that push, on and off the pitch. He is one of the most experienced members of Alonso’s squad and is embracing his role as a dressing room leader despite being in his debut campaign at the Bridge. ‘I think it's important to use the experience that you've had in your career, not just when I was at Liverpool, but at other clubs that I've been at,’ he added. ‘I've been abroad and come back, so I've had a lot of different experiences that I can try and help in certain situations for the team. ‘But ultimately, at the same time, I just want to focus on playing football, playing well, training well, and if I do that then that's the biggest help I can show for the team. ‘I'm a little bit older compared to some, but I just try to be myself and try to help other people around me, whether that's in training or in games, and just do what I've done for a long time: be a good team-mate, try to help other people and try to perform to the best of my ability to help the team. ‘There's a good group of lads. I just try to be myself and lead by example as much as possible to help everybody around me in the team. But there are a lot of other players that lead by example, and it's about getting the best out of everyone, creating a good culture within the team and working hard every day. ‘I think we're on the right path and we just need to continue on that road.’ The next twist on that road which must be negotiated is a home game against old rivals Leeds. It is a challenge that Henderson knows will require the Blues to be at our best, with our opponents just two points behind us in the Premier League table. ‘It will be a very tough game against a very good team. I think they've been very good this season again. They have some really good players and are very difficult to play against, so I'm expecting a really tough game. ‘I suppose every game in the Premier League is tough, but Leeds are a very good team, so we have to be at our very best if we want to win. 'We had a bad result before the last international break and responded well, so we'll be looking to do the same again. It's important to train well this week and get ready for a big game on Saturday.’
news.body_zh: 乔丹·亨德森表示，他和国际比赛日期间留在科巴姆的其他切尔西球员一直在努力建立节奏，以便在每场英超比赛中发挥出最佳状态。虽然蓝军队的几名成员在过去十天里代表各自的国家出战，但亨德森是留在我们训练基地与哈维·阿隆索一起训练的人之一。在国内赛程暂停之前，亨德森和他的蓝军同胞在四场英超比赛中取得了三连胜。但我们在中场休息时的表现令人失望，阿隆索的球队0-1输给了桑德兰。本周末我们将重返英超联赛，周六将在斯坦福桥迎战利兹联。这场比赛将在冬季开始，在此期间，蓝军希望将我们的不稳定因素抛诸脑后，对前四名发起持续的进攻。 “我认为有一些好的事情，但当然，我们可以改进一些事情，”亨德森说，利用这次暂停来反思迄今为止的 2026/27 赛季。 “有点不一致，但这就是我们正在努力变得更好和改进的地方，每天都在训练和比赛中努力保持一致，以获得我们作为一个团队可以实现的最佳表现，并成为最好的自己。” “因此，我们将继续努力，希望整个赛季都能持续下去，赛季持续的时间越长，我们的表现就越稳定、更有节奏。” “重要的是不要看得太远。这个赛季还有很长的路要走，还有很多积分、很多比赛要打。因此，现在只需专注于下一个。 “我认为我们已经展示了一些好的东西，但我们还需要改进。所以这是一场一场的比赛，表明我们可以在每场比赛中竞争并确保一致性。当我们这样做时，结果就会水到渠成。”这位 36 岁的球员很可能在球场内外发挥重要作用。他是阿隆索队中经验最丰富的成员之一，尽管这是他在蓝桥的处子秀，但他正在接受自己作为更衣室领袖的角色。 “我认为利用你职业生涯中的经验很重要，不仅仅是我在利物浦时的经验，还有我效力过的其他俱乐部的经验，”他补充道。 “我出过国又回来，所以我有很多不同的经历，我可以尝试在某些情况下为球队提供帮助。 “但最终，我只想专注于踢球，踢好球，训练好，如果我做到了，那就是我能为球队提供的最大帮助。” “与某些人相比，我的年龄有点大，但我只是尽力做自己，并尽力帮助周围的其他人，无论是在训练中还是在比赛中，并且只是做我长期以来所做的事情：成为一名好队友，尽力帮助其他人，并尽力表现出最好的能力来帮助球队。 ‘有一群很好的小伙子。我只是尽力做我自己，并尽可能以身作则，帮助团队中我周围的每个人。但还有很多其他球员以身作则，这就是让每个人都发挥出最好的一面，在团队内创造良好的文化并每天努力工作。 “我认为我们走在正确的道路上，我们只需要继续沿着这条路走下去。”这条道路上必须协商的下一个转折是主场对阵老对手利兹联的比赛。亨德森知道，这是一项挑战，要求蓝军发挥出最佳状态，而我们的对手在英超积分榜上仅落后我们两分。 ‘这将是一场非常艰难的比赛，对手是一支非常优秀的球队。我认为他们这个赛季再次表现得非常好。他们有一些非常优秀的球员，而且很难对抗，所以我期待一场非常艰难的比赛。 “我认为英超联赛的每场比赛都很艰难，但利兹联是一支非常优秀的球队，所以如果我们想获胜，我们就必须发挥出最佳状态。 “我们在上一次国际比赛日之前取得了糟糕的成绩，但我们的反应很好，所以我们希望再次做到同样的事情。这周好好训练并为周六的一场重要比赛做好准备很重要。”

news.title: Walsh outlines importance of Blues' competitive mentality after PSG win
news.title_zh: 沃尔什概述了巴黎圣日尔曼获胜后蓝军竞争心态的重要性
news.body_en: Keira Walsh believes Chelsea's squad depth is proving crucial during a demanding run of fixtures, with the midfielder praising the impact of our substitutes in Wednesday's hard-fought victory over Paris Saint-Germain. The Blues had to work for all three points at Plough Lane in our latest Champions League fixture; we had to stay patient to break down a determined PSG defence before Veerle Buurman's 87th-minute winner secured an important victory. And Walsh highlighted the contributions of Erin Cuthbert and Maika Hamano, who were introduced together on the hour and injected fresh energy into our attacking play. 'It's been a tough period and a lot of players have played different positions; there have been a lot of rotations,' said Walsh. 'Maika and Erin made a massive difference; they brought intensity and created a lot for us at the end.' 'That's the really good thing about being at Chelsea, we've got a really competitive squad and we can win these games.' Cuthbert was particularly influential in the closing stages, delivering several dangerous corners before her late set-piece eventually led to Buurman's winner. The victory was far from straightforward, with PSG's organised defensive shape frustrating the Blues for much of the evening. However, Walsh believes the determination from Sonia Bompastor's side to keep pushing and force the breakthrough could prove significant in the race for automatic quarter-final qualification. She said: 'It was a massive win. It was a tough game for us tonight; they defended really well and were aggressive. 'It was a difficult game physically but, obviously, we left it late, and to get the win was really important. And hopefully it will push us on into the top four.' While Chelsea had to remain patient in attack, our defensive resilience was again evident as Hannah Hampton recorded another clean sheet. The Blues have now kept five consecutive clean sheets in this season's league phase, an impressive achievement which Walsh believes reflects the emphasis placed on defensive discipline throughout the squad. 'I think our defence, whoever plays there, is really solid and that [keeping clean sheets] is something we're really concentrating on this year compared to last season. 'If you keep clean sheets, it really helps and if you're not scoring a lot of goals, it can help you still get these wins.'
news.body_zh: 凯拉·沃尔什认为，在一场艰苦的比赛中，切尔西的阵容深度至关重要，这位中场球员赞扬了我们的替补球员在周三苦战战胜巴黎圣日耳曼的比赛中所发挥的作用。在我们最新的欧冠比赛中，蓝军必须在普劳巷努力争取全取三分；我们必须保持耐心，才能打破巴黎圣日耳曼的防守，然后维尔勒·布尔曼 (Veerle Buurman) 在第 87 分钟的制胜球取得了重要的胜利。沃尔什强调了艾琳·库斯伯特和麦卡·滨野的贡献，他们在这一小时被一起介绍，为我们的进攻注入了新的能量。 “这是一段艰难的时期，很多球员都踢过不同的位置；沃尔什说：“有很多轮换。” “麦卡和艾琳带来了巨大的改变；他们给我们带来了强度，并在最后为我们创造了很多东西。” “这是在切尔西的真正好处，我们拥有一支非常有竞争力的球队，我们可以赢得这些比赛。”库斯伯特在最后阶段的影响力尤其大，她在最后时刻的定位球最终为布尔曼赢得了制胜球，她送出了几个危险的角球。这场胜利远非一帆风顺，巴黎圣日尔曼有组织的防守阵型让蓝军在晚上的大部分时间都感到沮丧。然而，沃尔什相信索尼娅·邦帕斯托尔队继续推动并突破的决心可能会在自动进入四分之一决赛资格的竞争中发挥重要作用。她说：“这是一场巨大的胜利。今晚对我们来说这是一场艰难的比赛；他们防守得很好而且很有侵略性。 “这是一场体力上很困难的比赛，但显然我们迟到了，赢得胜利真的很重要。希望这能让我们进入前四。”虽然切尔西在进攻中必须保持耐心，但汉娜·汉普顿再次零失球，我们的防守弹性再次显现出来。蓝军在本赛季的联赛中已经连续五场不失球，沃尔什认为这一令人印象深刻的成就反映了整个球队对防守纪律的重视。 “我认为我们的防守，无论谁在那里踢球，都非常坚固，与上赛季相比，[保持不失球]是我们今年真正关注的事情。 “如果你保持不失球，这确实有帮助，如果你没有进很多球，它仍然可以帮助你获得这些胜利。”

news.title: Bompastor: Everyone in the team loves to defend
news.title_zh: Bompastor：球队中的每个人都喜欢防守
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor praised her Chelsea side's commitment to defending as another clean sheet helped the Blues secure a hard-fought 1-0 UEFA Women's Champions League win over Paris Saint-Germain. Veerle Buurman's 87th-minute winner earned us three vital points at Plough Lane, but our head coach was equally encouraged by the determination shown without the ball as Chelsea recorded a sixth successive European clean sheet. 'What I'm really pleased about right now is that everyone in the team loves to defend,' Bompastor said. 'We don't want to concede goals and we have a lot of quality in doing that as a team, but also some really good individuals who can defend our goal.' Bompastor believes that shared responsibility is essential to competing for silverware, particularly against opponents capable of punishing the smallest lapse. 'It's important not to concede many goals, especially when you want to go far in every competition. My job is to make sure we find the right balance between being strong defensively and creating chances and scoring goals.' That balance was tested against a PSG side who sat deep, proved difficult to break down for much of the evening, and consistently tried to his us on the counter-attack. 'I knew coming into this game, having watched a lot of PSG's previous matches, that it would be difficult,' Bompastor explained. 'They were very compact, happy to defend and protect the central areas really well. We created more chances in the second half and I think, in the end, we deserved to win.' The breakthrough eventually arrived from a corner, with Buurman turning the ball home after Bompastor's substitutions had helped Chelsea build greater attacking momentum. The victory was also another example of the flexibility within her squad, with the Blues switching between defensive systems despite a demanding fixture schedule and several injury absences. 'I think you could see tonight that we defended with both a back three and a back four, and the players still showed that confidence,' she said. The Blues head coach stressed that keeping everyone aligned in different roles takes work, but believes healthy competition is helping to drive standards higher. 'It's also about the quality of the players on the pitch. Right now, a lot of them are performing at a really good level. The competition for places in our backline is really high, which is good for us, and we need to keep that going.' For Bompastor, our late winner was a reward for perseverance, with Chelsea finding the decisive moment without compromising the defensive quality that has become a hallmark of our European campaign. 'Sometimes in football you need to find a way to win, and tonight's result was really important for us.'
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托赞扬了她的切尔西队在防守上的承诺，因为另一场不失球帮助蓝军在欧洲女子冠军联赛中以 1-0 的比分战胜了巴黎圣日耳曼队。维尔勒·布尔曼第 87 分钟的制胜球为我们在普劳巷赢得了关键的三分，但我们的主教练同样对无球时表现出的决心感到鼓舞，切尔西连续第六次欧洲不失球。 “我现在真正感到高兴的是球队中的每个人都喜欢防守，”邦帕斯特说。 “我们不想丢球，作为一个团队，我们有很多能力做到这一点，但也有一些非常优秀的个人可以捍卫我们的目标。”邦帕斯托认为，共同承担责任对于争夺奖杯至关重要，尤其是面对能够惩罚哪怕是最微小失误的对手。 “不要丢太多球很重要，尤其是当你想在每场比赛中走得更远时。我的工作是确保我们在强大的防守与创造机会和进球之间找到适当的平衡。”这种平衡在巴黎圣日耳曼队的比赛中受到了考验，巴黎圣日耳曼队在晚上的大部分时间里都很难被打破，并且不断地在反击中试图逼迫我们。 “我看了很多巴黎圣日耳曼之前的比赛，知道参加这场比赛会很困难，”邦帕斯特解释道。 “他们非常紧凑，乐于很好地保卫和保护中心地区。我们在下半场创造了更多机会，我认为最终我们配得上胜利。”最终突破来自角球，在邦帕斯特的换人帮助切尔西建立了更大的进攻势头后，布尔曼将球打入球门。这场胜利也是球队内部灵活性的另一个例子，尽管赛程安排严格且多次因伤缺席，但蓝军在防守体系之间进行切换。 “我想你今晚可以看到我们用三后卫和四后卫进行防守，球员们仍然表现出了这种信心，”她说。蓝军主教练强调，让每个人在不同的角色上保持一致需要付出努力，但他相信良性竞争有助于提高标准。 “这也与球场上球员的素质有关。现在，他们中的很多人都表现得非常好。我们后防线位置的竞争非常激烈，这对我们有好处，我们需要保持这种状态。”对于邦帕斯托尔来说，我们最后的制胜球是对坚持不懈的奖励，切尔西在不影响防守质量的情况下找到了决定性的时刻，这已成为我们欧洲赛场的标志。 “有时在足球比赛中你需要找到获胜的方法，今晚的结果对我们来说非常重要。”

news.title: Match report: Chelsea Women 1-0 Paris Saint-Germain
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西女足 1-0 巴黎圣日耳曼
news.body_en: Veerle Buurman's late winner secured a precious 1-0 victory over Paris Saint-Germain at Plough Lane, lifting Chelsea top of the UEFA Women's Champions League league phase table with one match remaining. The Blues dominated possession but found it tough to convert chances against a disciplined PSG backline, but Buurman struck from close range following an 87th-minute corner. Sjoeke Nusken had been denied moments earlier by a magnificent save from Katarzyna Kiedrzynek, whose performance kept PSG level for much of the evening. It was another hard-earned victory for Sonia Bompastor's side, who maintained our unbeaten start to the campaign and recorded a fifth successive clean sheet in the Champions League. The result was significant after two goalless draws with Lyon and Hacken had left us needing a strong finish to the league phase. The Blues had won both European home fixtures this season, but PSG provided a different examination of our attacking patience. Bompastor made three alterations from Saturday's 1-0 Women's Super League victory over Manchester City. Nathalie Bjorn captained the Blues in place of Lucy Bronze, while Buurman replaced Kadeisha Buchanan and Aggie Beever-Jones came in for the injured Melvine Malard. The Blues quickly established control of the contest but found PSG's organised defensive shape difficult to break down. Potter had our first presentable opening in the 10th minute, meeting a corner with a free header but directing her effort wide. PSG suffered an early setback when defender Isabela was forced off injured in the 15th minute, with Olga Carmona replacing her. The visitors nevertheless remained dangerous on the break. Merveille Kanjinga offered their most persistent attacking threat down the right, demanding strong defending from Katie McCabe and the Chelsea backline. At the other end, Beever-Jones found space to meet a delivery with her head but could not direct it toward goal as clear openings remained scarce. Our best first-half opportunity arrived just before the interval. Baltimore's effort was kept out by Kiedrzynek, with Thompson reacting to the rebound but unable to force the loose ball home. Although our midfielders found space to collect the ball, PSG kept numbers behind it and protected the central areas. Bompastor's side were forced into wide deliveries, with Beever-Jones often crowded out before she could turn towards goal. Despite enjoying the majority of possession and registering seven attempts before the break, Chelsea went into half-time without making the breakthrough. PSG, meanwhile, had not forced Hannah Hampton into a save. The visitors offered more attacking ambition after the restart, and Hampton was finally called upon in the 53rd minute when Kanjinga drove towards goal and tested her at the near post. Buurman and Bjorn were alert whenever PSG threatened on the counterattack, while Potter remained composed in midfield as we continued to probe for an opening. Bompastor turned to her substitutes on the hour, introducing Erin Cuthbert, Maika Hamano and Bronze for Wieke Kaptein, Thompson and McCabe. The changes gave Chelsea fresh impetus. Cuthbert's set-piece delivery caused problems for the PSG defence, with Kiedrzynek producing another important stop following a corner. Cuthbert then worked an opening on the edge of the area but was unable to get her shot away cleanly under pressure. PSG almost punished us at the other end when Tara Elimbi Gilbert lifted an effort over the bar after a threatening counterattack involving Kanjinga and 16-year-old substitute Alyssa Charlier. With Cuthbert providing urgency from midfield and sharper deliveries from set-pieces, Chelsea began to find more promising positions. The visitors remained stubborn, however, and it appeared that a single moment might decide this finely balanced encounter. Beever-Jones sent a free-kick over the crossbar before making way for Nisken in the closing stages. The German midfielder made an immediate impression, meeting a delivery with a firm header that looked destined for goal until Kiedrzynek produced an exceptional reaction save. But the resulting corner finally broke PSG's resistance. Cuthbert delivered into the crowded penalty area and, after the ball was not cleared, Buurman reacted sharply at the near post to turn it home in the 87th minute. There was still defending to do, though, and Hampton stood firm as PSG pressed for an equaliser, including a late effort from Mbock. The final whistle confirmed another clean sheet and three valuable European points after a patient and determined display that, until the end, appeared to be heading for a draw. We remain unbeaten after five league-phase matches, with our fate to be decided in the final round. We currently lead the table, with the top four advancing directly into the knockout phase. The Blues visit Liverpool in the WSL on Saturday before concluding the Champions League league phase away to OH Leuven on 16 December. Chelsea: Hampton, Carpenter, Bjorn (c), Buurman, McCabe (Bronze 60), Walsh, Potter, Thompson (Hamano 60), Kaptein (Cuthbert 60), Baltimore, Beever-Jones (Nusken 83). Unused substitutes: Peng, Spencer, Buchanan, Las, Dragoni, Brown. Goalscorer: Buurman 87. Booked: Bronze 89. Paris Saint-Germain: Kiedrzynek, Isabela (Carmona 15), Mbock (c), Samoura, Elimbi Gilbert, Echegini (Morissaint 90), Groenen, Osteras, Le Guilly, Feller (Charlier 68), Kanjinga. Unused substitutes: Toussaint, Szperkowska, Fatier, Yaya, Jourde, Le Roux, Imarazene, Lafontaine. Referee: Maria Sole Ferrieri Caputi.
news.body_zh: 维尔勒·布尔曼 (Veerle Buurman) 的绝杀球帮助切尔西在普劳巷 (Plough Lane) 1-0 战胜巴黎圣日耳曼队，在还剩一场比赛的情况下，让切尔西在欧洲女子冠军联赛阶段积分榜上名列前茅。蓝军占据了控球权，但发现面对纪律严明的巴黎圣日耳曼后防线，很难抓住机会，但布尔曼在第 87 分钟开出角球后近距离射门。早些时候，斯约克·努斯肯被卡塔兹娜·基德尔兹内克 (Katarzyna Kiedrzynek) 的精彩扑救挡出，她的表现让巴黎圣日耳曼队在晚上的大部分时间里都保持着水平。对于索尼娅·邦帕斯托尔的球队来说，这是又一场来之不易的胜利，他们保持了赛季不败的开局，并在欧冠联赛中实现了连续第五次不失球。在与里昂和哈肯两场互交白卷后，我们需要在联赛阶段取得强劲的成绩，结果意义重大。蓝军本赛季赢得了两场欧洲主场比赛，但巴黎圣日耳曼对我们的进攻耐心进行了不同的考验。庞帕斯特在周六女超联赛1-0战胜曼城的比赛中做出了三处调整。纳塔莉·比约恩 (Nathalie Bjorn) 接替露西·青铜 (Lucy Bronze) 担任蓝军队长，布尔曼 (Buurman) 接替卡德伊莎·布坎南 (Kadeisha Buchanan)，阿吉·比弗·琼斯 (Aggie Beever-Jones) 顶替受伤的梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard)。蓝军很快就控制了比赛，但发现巴黎圣日尔曼有组织的防守阵型很难被打破。波特在第 10 分钟获得了我们的第一个漂亮的开局，接到角球后头球攻门，但球偏出了球门。巴黎圣日耳曼队在比赛初期遭遇挫折，后卫伊莎贝拉在第 15 分钟受伤下场，奥尔加·卡莫纳取代了她。尽管如此，客队在中场休息时仍然很危险。默维尔·坎金加在右路提供了他们最持久的进攻威胁，要求凯蒂·麦凯布和切尔西后防线提供强有力的防守。在另一端，比弗-琼斯找到了用头接球的空间，但无法将其引导到球门，因为仍然缺乏清晰的空位。我们上半场最好的机会就在中场休息前到来。巴尔的摩的射门被基德尔日内克挡出，汤普森对篮板做出反应，但无法将球强行送入球门。尽管我们的中场球员找到了接球的空间，但巴黎圣日耳曼仍将人数限制在球后并保护中场。庞帕斯特的球队被迫广泛传球，比弗-琼斯经常在她转向球门之前将球挡出。尽管切尔西占据了大部分控球权并在中场休息前进行了七次尝试，但切尔西在半场结束时却没有取得突破。与此同时，巴黎圣日耳曼并没有迫使汉娜·汉普顿进行扑救。比赛重新开始后，客队展现出了更多的进攻野心，汉普顿终于在第53分钟得到了出场机会，坎金加带球冲向球门，并在近门柱处考验了她。每当巴黎圣日尔曼发起反击威胁时，布尔曼和比约恩都会保持警惕，而波特则在中场保持冷静，我们继续寻找空档。庞帕斯托在这一小时内换上了替补，介绍了艾琳·库斯伯特、麦卡·滨野，并用铜牌替换了维克·卡普坦、汤普森和麦凯布。这些变化给切尔西带来了新的动力。库斯伯特的定位球给巴黎圣日耳曼的后防线带来了麻烦，基德尔日内克在角球后又完成了一次重要的扑救。卡斯伯特随后在禁区边缘创造了一个空当，但在压力下未能干净利落地射门。巴黎圣日尔曼在另一端差点惩罚了我们，塔拉·埃里姆比·吉尔伯特在坎金加和 16 岁替补阿丽莎·查利尔的威胁性反击后将一脚射门高出横梁。随着卡斯伯特在中场提供紧迫感，并在定位球中提供更犀利的传球，切尔西开始寻找更有前途的位置。然而，客队仍然很顽固，似乎一个瞬间就可能决定这场微妙平衡的遭遇。比弗-琼斯的任意球越过横梁，然后在最后阶段为尼斯肯让路。这位德国中场球员立即给人留下了深刻的印象，他的头球有力，看起来注定要进球，直到基德尔日内克做出了出色的反应扑救。但由此产生的角球最终打破了巴黎圣日耳曼的抵抗。第87分钟，库斯伯特传球到拥挤的禁区，皮球没有被解围，布尔曼在近门柱反应敏捷，将球打入球门。不过，仍有防守要做，汉普顿在巴黎圣日耳曼试图扳平比分时站稳了脚跟，包括姆博克最后时刻的射门。 经过耐心而坚定的表现，终场哨声确认了另一场不失球和三分宝贵的欧洲积分，直到比赛结束，球队似乎都将迎来平局。我们在联赛阶段的五场比赛后保持不败，我们的命运将在最后一轮决定。目前我们领先积分榜，前四名直接进入淘汰赛阶段。蓝军将于周六在 WSL 中客场挑战利物浦，然后于 12 月 16 日客场挑战鲁汶大学，结束欧冠联赛阶段比赛。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、比约恩（三）、布尔曼、麦凯布（青铜 60）、沃尔什、波特、汤普森（滨野 60）、卡普坦（卡斯伯特 60）、巴尔的摩、比弗-琼斯（努斯肯 83）。未上场替补：彭、斯宾塞、布坎南、拉斯、德拉戈尼、布朗。进球者：布尔曼 87。黄牌：铜牌 89。巴黎圣日耳曼：基德尔日内克、伊莎贝拉（卡莫纳 15）、姆博克（中）、萨穆拉、埃林比·吉尔伯特、埃切吉尼（莫里桑 90）、格罗宁、奥斯特拉斯、勒吉利、费勒（查理 news.title: Cuthbert taking confidence from team-mates’ quality for ‘proper Champions League night’
news.title_zh: 库斯伯特对队友的能力充满信心，以度过“适当的冠军联赛之夜”
news.body_en: Erin Cuthbert can’t wait for another big night in the UEFA Women’s Champions League when Chelsea host Paris Saint-Germain at Plough Lane, and called on her fellow Blues to show their quality once again to follow up a crucial win over Manchester City with another in Europe. Chelsea defeated Man City in a top-of-the-table Women’s Super League clash at Stamford Bridge on Saturday to go clear in first place in the table. Now, attention shifts just down the road to Plough Lane, where we are hoping to do the same in the Champions League. With both teams within striking distance of the automatic qualification places in the league phase – just one goal away in Chelsea’s case – captain Cuthbert is anticipating a mouthwatering tie when Paris Saint-Germain come to west London. ‘I honestly relish playing these games,’ said the midfielder. ‘As a football player you want to be playing in the biggest games under the lights in Wimbledon, so we're really excited by the opportunity. ‘I love playing against the top clubs. They always bring a good away support as well that will create a good atmosphere. So it will feel like a proper Champions League night.’ Cuthbert is also going into the game full of confidence in Chelsea’s ability, with the Blues remaining unbeaten in the Champions League and yet to concede a goal in the league phase, having picked up maximum points from our home games so far. ‘I get a lot of my confidence from looking around me, looking at the quality of players that we have,’ she continued. ‘I think you saw over the course of the season the amount of goal scorers that have chipped in across the season. As an opponent, that's really difficult to defend against, knowing that everyone can chip in with goals. They can come from different places, so I think that's really important. ‘But we've got a really good team camaraderie. Everyone's encouraging each other. I think even against Hacken, when the goal wasn't coming, you could see the urgency, but with calm. That's important, that we show a little bit of urgency because we want to score goals, but we do it in a calm and composed manner. ‘Everybody's been so good and I think it's the resilience in the squad. You can see that everybody is up for the fight and up for the battle. Whenever there's tough times, everybody just puts their head down and keeps working. ‘The work ethic and the work rate and intensity that we've been going at this season has been really impressive. Nobody's willing to stop and we're all trying to one-up each other on how much we can do. That's only going to push the squad to new heights.’ Our skipper won’t be underestimating the size of the challenge that awaits on Wednesday evening though, knowing we face a Paris Saint-Germain side with plenty of quality of their own, as well as being determined to bounce back from a defeat to Bayern Munich last time out – their first of the current campaign. ‘They've had a little bit of a difficult start in terms of who they've played opponent-wise, but everybody knows the quality of PSG,’ Cuthbert concluded. ‘They've been one of the top clubs in Europe for as long as I can remember and as long as I've been at Chelsea. ‘I've played them many times, had some late moments against PSG as well. They'll be wanting to pick up points. It's been a tough run for them, so I'm sure they'll be hungry. If I was in that dressing room and we've not had the start that we wanted, I would be making sure that everybody's up for the game tonight. So I'm expecting a tough one. ‘But I'm expecting us to be on it, and that's the beauty of it. We played Manchester City on Saturday, but we have to go again. That performance means nothing unless we back it up tonight.’
news.body_zh: 艾琳·库斯伯特迫不及待地等待切尔西在普洛巷主场迎战巴黎圣日耳曼队在欧洲女子冠军联赛中的另一个重要夜晚，并呼吁她的蓝军同胞们再次展现自己的实力，继在欧洲击败曼城后再次取得关键胜利。周六，切尔西在斯坦福桥举行的女足超级联赛积分榜榜首比赛中击败曼城，夺得积分榜第一。现在，注意力转移到了犁巷，我们希望在冠军联赛中也能做到同样的事情。由于两支球队都距离联赛阶段的自动晋级席位很近——切尔西队只差一球——队长库斯伯特预计巴黎圣日耳曼队来到西伦敦时将会有一场令人垂涎的平局。 “老实说，我很喜欢玩这些比赛，”这位中场球员说。 “作为一名足球运动员，你希望在温布尔登的灯光下参加最重要的比赛，所以我们对这个机会感到非常兴奋。 “我喜欢与顶级俱乐部比赛。他们总是带来良好的客场支持，这将营造良好的氛围。所以这感觉就像是一个真正的欧冠之夜。”库斯伯特在比赛开始时也对切尔西的能力充满信心，蓝军在欧冠联赛中保持不败，在联赛阶段尚未失球，迄今为止在我们的主场比赛中获得了最高分。 “环顾四周，看看我们球员的素质，我获得了很大的信心，”她继续说道。 “我认为你在整个赛季中看到了整个赛季贡献的进球数。作为对手，这真的很难防守，因为知道每个人都可以进球。他们可以来自不同的地方，所以我认为这非常重要。 “但我们有非常好的团队友情。大家都在互相鼓励。我认为即使是对阵哈肯，当进球没有到来时，你也能看到紧迫感，但保持冷静。这很重要，我们表现出一点紧迫感，因为我们想要进球，但我们会以冷静和沉着的方式做到这一点。 “每个人都表现得很好，我认为这是球队的韧性。你可以看到，每个人都准备好战斗，准备战斗。每当遇到困难的时候，大家都会低下头继续努力。 “本赛季我们的职业道德、工作效率和强度确实令人印象深刻。没有人愿意停下来，我们都在努力互相比拼我们能做多少。这只会将球队推向新的高度。不过，我们的队长不会低估周三晚上等待的挑战的规模，因为他知道我们将面对一支实力雄厚的巴黎圣日耳曼队，并且决心从上次输给拜仁慕尼黑的比赛中恢复过来——这是他们本赛季的第一场比赛。 “就对阵对手而言，他们的开局有点困难，但每个人都知道巴黎圣日耳曼的实力，”库斯伯特总结道。 “从我记事起以及我在切尔西效力以来，他们一直是欧洲顶级俱乐部之一。 “我和他们交手过很多次，在对阵巴黎圣日耳曼的比赛中也有过一些最后时刻。他们会想要得分。这对他们来说是一次艰难的跑步，所以我确信他们会感到饥饿。如果我在更衣室里而我们还没有得到我们想要的开局，我会确保每个人都准备好参加今晚的比赛。所以我期待着一场艰难的比赛。 “但我期待我们能够参与其中，这就是它的美妙之处。周六我们对阵曼城，但我们必须再去一次。除非我们今晚支持它，否则这种表现毫无意义。

news.title: Internationals: Martinez returns and Anselmino debuts in huge Argentina win
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：马丁内斯回归，安塞尔米诺首次亮相阿根廷大胜
news.body_en: Several Chelsea players were involved as our South American contingent brought this international window to a close, including record-equalling Emiliano Martinez and Aaron Anselmino returning from injury as captain and debutant for Argentina. Argentina are beginning their post-Lionel Messi era in earnest during this break, having bid farewell to their legendary skipper and talisman last month. After losing to Uruguay last week, they were looking to kick-start things with a friendly against Costa Rica in the early hours of Wednesday morning UK time. With Messi no longer involved, manager Lionel Scaloni handed Martinez the captain’s armband, as the experienced goalkeeper made his first appearance since undergoing surgery on a fractured jaw suffered in Chelsea’s 2-0 win at Everton a month ago. Fellow Blues Anselmino and Valentin Barco were among the Argentina substitutes, as the Albiceleste wasted no time asserting their dominance by taking the lead inside the opening 10 minutes. By half-time they were four goals up, and added another shortly after the break. With 20 minutes remaining, Scaloni called on Anselmino from the bench, handing the young defender his first senior appearance for his country – and his first appearance of the campaign after suffering a thigh injury in pre-season. Two more goals followed to give Argentina an emphatic 7-0 victory, ending their November international window on a high. It was also the 47th clean sheet of Martinez's international career, on his 71st cap, matching Sergio Romero's all-time Argentina record. Ecuador were also in action on Wednesday morning as they hosted Bolivia and recorded their second 2-0 win of this break, having already defeated Costa Rica by the same scoreline. Moises Caicedo captained his country from the start before being withdrawn at half-time with their two-goal lead already secured. Teenager Kendry Paez came off the bench for the final 25 minutes.
news.body_zh: 当我们的南美队结束这个国际比赛窗口时，几名切尔西球员也参与其中，其中包括追平纪录的埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯和亚伦·安塞尔米诺，他们以队长身份伤愈复出，并首次代表阿根廷队出场。阿根廷队在上个月告别了他们的传奇队长和护身符后，在这个假期正式开始了后莱昂内尔·梅西时代。在上周输给乌拉圭后，他们希望在英国时间周三凌晨与哥斯达黎加进行一场友谊赛来拉开帷幕。由于梅西不再参与比赛，主教练莱昂内尔·斯卡洛尼将队长袖标交给了马丁内斯，这位经验丰富的门将在一个月前切尔西2-0战胜埃弗顿的比赛中下巴骨折接受手术后首次亮相。蓝军队友安塞尔米诺和瓦伦丁·巴尔科是阿根廷队的替补球员，阿尔比塞莱斯特队在开场 10 分钟内取得领先，立即确立了自己的统治地位。到半场结束时，他们已经领先四球，并在中场休息后不久又进一球。比赛还剩 20 分钟时，斯卡罗尼替补出场，让安塞尔米诺上场，这是这位年轻后卫首次代表国家队出场，也是他在季前赛大腿受伤后的本赛季首次出场。随后阿根廷队再进两球，以 7-0 大胜，以优异成绩结束 11 月份的国际比赛。这也是马丁内斯国家队职业生涯第 47 次不失球，这是他代表国家队出场 71 次，追平了塞尔吉奥·罗梅罗 (Sergio Romero) 为阿根廷队创造的历史纪录。周三上午，厄瓜多尔队也在主场迎战玻利维亚队，并以 2-0 的比分战胜了哥斯达黎加队，取得了本次比赛的第二场胜利。莫伊塞斯·凯塞多（Moises Caicedo）从一开始就担任国家队队长，但在半场结束时被撤回，他们已经确保了两球领先优势。青少年肯德利·佩兹 (Kendry Paez) 在最后 25 分钟替补出场。

news.title: Juan Mata retires: Forward's lifelong bonds to Chelsea and London
news.title_zh: 胡安·马塔退役：前锋与切尔西和伦敦的终生联系
news.body_en: With the news Juan Mata has announced his retirement, we revisit an interview we conducted with the Spaniard a few years ago, in which he reflects on his love affair with this club and this city that will leave him forever grateful for the time he spent at Stamford Bridge... Mata was part of a close-knit quartet of Spaniards who formed lasting friendships at Chelsea. It was on 22 August 2011 that Chelsea and Valencia agreed a deal for the playmaker to leave his homeland. In the years since, he has taken in further spells at Manchester United, Galatasaray, Vissel Kobe and now Western Sydney Wanderers. He has established himself as a fan favourite at every club, in part for his performances, personality and creative style of play, but also because he has embraced the life and culture of each club's respective city. The regular blog he wrote during his time at Chelsea was devoted equally to updates on his football career and his travels exploring London, full of his own photography. Yes, he was a great player for the Blues. But more than that, he became one of us, an adopted Londoner who felt the pulse of the club and the city. ‘I like that and I always try to do the same,’ he explained. ‘I did the same in Turkey, in Istanbul, which is an incredible city, and in Japan. I find it important to get to know my surroundings, the culture and the history around the city where I live. ‘I feel very privileged to have had the opportunity to live in London, in Manchester, in Istanbul, in Japan and Australia. I’m getting to know different cultures, different vibes of cities, and I’ve tried to embrace it as much as I can.’ There’s no question Mata has achieved a rare balance in his life. You only have to look at the success and longevity of his career, still playing top-flight football at the age of 37, to know he is a dedicated professional. But he is also aware there is more to life and happiness than football. Of course, that doesn’t mean the sport he loves isn’t a great source of pride and pleasure for him. How could it not be for someone who has had so many career highs, prime among them his time at Stamford Bridge. His first season with Chelsea was one that has gone down in history. In 2012, Mata couldn’t stop winning. He made more appearances than any other outfield Chelsea player as the trophies began to arrive in quick succession in 2011/12 – and Mata was at the heart of things. He netted in the 5-1 thrashing of rivals Tottenham Hotspur in the FA Cup semi-final, a competition we would win. He scored the crucial away goal in the UEFA Champions League last 16 against Napoli that made our famous comeback at Stamford Bridge possible. And he provided the perfect assist for Didier Drogba to equalise in the final as we became the first London club to be crowned European champions. Like Fernando Torres, Mata wasn’t finished there - both of Chelsea’s representatives in the Spanish national team found the net to help their country beat Italy 4-0 in the 2012 UEFA European Championship final. ‘Fernando was in the same situation as me,’ Juan reflected thoughtfully. ‘The good thing is that when you win and enjoy it so much, there is a point it seems like winning is all there is. That is the problem. When you don’t win any more you realise how difficult that is. ‘But it was an incredible time and we feel so lucky in 2012 to have been able to win the FA Cup, then the Champions League, then the Euros with Spain, both of us scoring in the final. It was an incredible two or three months, probably the best summer in my life. ‘With time you get to realise how difficult that is in a playing career. To win one of those trophies is a lot, but having the chance to win those trophies together, it’s like a dream. We were riding a wave of positivity, of good football, and especially good results. It was incredible.’ Ever modest, Juan says ‘it was incredible’. For the Chelsea supporters in the stands, it was more often ‘he is incredible’. They said as much when they voted Mata the club’s Player of the Year for 2011/12, and again the following season, when it was joined on his mantelpiece by the Players’ Player of the Year award. Despite it being Mata's first time living abroad, there were no problems settling in England, on and off the pitch. According to Juan, that is because one goes hand in hand with the other. ‘I loved it,’ he replied emphatically, when asked how he found living in a different country for the first time. ‘As soon as I arrived in London I felt a great energy. It was positive from when I first arrived. ‘Of course, London is a great city. I loved my life in London, getting to know a different country, different culture, different language. A city with a lot of opportunities. ‘On the pitch, it worked perfectly from the first minute - I remember scoring on my debut. So it was a big change in my life, leaving Spain, leaving Valencia where I was living for four years, but I felt it was the right time and I’m so happy that I did. ‘My team-mates were great, we had a great dressing room. For example, in my case, Fernando Torres, and the captain and leaders - John Terry, Petr Cech, Frank Lampard. 'They were very helpful in the beginning and offered their help for anything I might have needed. With their help, and also with my willingness to discover London and settle in, it was a fairly quick adaptation.’ Among those team-mates he had support readily available in the form of what soon became a close community of Spanish players. There was the more experienced Fernando Torres, who had signed for Chelsea from Liverpool the previous January, Oriol Romeu arrived from Barcelona a few weeks before Juan in August 2011, and Cesar Azpilicueta would join them the following summer. ‘It was super important. First, to have Fernando; he was actually very important in the decision to go to Chelsea. He called me before when the interest was there and he told me how life was there, how the club wanted me and the coach. 'It made my decision easier. I had so much respect, admiration and love for Fernando as a player and a person. He was a great help. ‘Oriol arrived at the same time and he is one of the best humans I’ve met in my whole life, not only in football. It was fantastic to be there with him, to get to know such an amazing personality. We still speak a lot. 'It was definitely one of my positives at Chelsea to get to know Fernando better and get to know Oriol, and Azpi, who arrived later. ‘We were more than team-mates, we were friends. Of course, my relationship with Fernando had already begun before with the national team, but because of our time together at Chelsea we became close friends. 'I consider him one of my best friends in my career. He was older and he was more experienced. He was a very important player; he was always giving me advice and the others. He was very important for all of us and I learned so much from him. ‘I also already knew Azpi from the national team and the Under-21s and the younger generations, but again we made a strong relationship. ‘With Oriol, we were living in the same building in Battersea, so we were going to training and back in the same car together most of the time. I got to know his amazing family, he got to know mine. 'We used to watch football together, on Champions League nights. We used to have dinner together. On days off we would make plans together in London. We were friends and we spent so much time together. And I can tell you, with a guy like Ori, he is someone you want to spend time with because your day will improve if you are around him! ‘We found Spanish restaurants. The famous Cambio de Tercio on Old Brompton Road we used to go to a lot. Oriol also had friends who worked in restaurants in the east part of the city and doing Spanish guided tours. 'There are a lot of nationalities in London and a lot of Spanish people, plus we had a lot of visitors to watch games and things. So we were never bored! ‘The four of us are very good friends and I’m very grateful we spent so much time together, but we also integrated ourselves very good in the dressing room with all of the personalities and other cultures and nationalities. 'I think that was the key with winning the Champions League, the FA Cup and the Europa League, to have a great energy in the dressing room.’ Mata and Azpilicueta were relatively early in their careers when they joined Chelsea. What the latter went on to achieve, becoming Chelsea captain and winning every piece of silverware going at Stamford Bridge, was yet to be written. However, Mata confirms the attributes which made Azpi such a success were already apparent when he signed from Marseille in 2012. ‘He already had some experience in football, mainly in the Spanish and French leagues, but you could see already his determination. I think Azpi is a guy who has achieved what he has achieved because of his professionalism and his mind-set and his determination. 'On top of his qualities as a player, for me his key feature is his mind, and you could already see it in the beginning. ‘He had some trouble, having not as much game time as he wanted in the beginning, but he was very determined waiting for his chance and he got what he deserved. 'He had an incredible career at Chelsea, winning so many trophies, being the captain for some time. He’s a legend at the club and he got the recognition that he deserved because he committed 100 per cent to his profession.’ It was not just with his fellow players that Mata had a great relationship with at Chelsea. There is no mistaking the high regard he and the Blues supporters held each other in – and that bond has continued long after his own departure in January 2014. ‘I still get that feeling from Chelsea fans. I’m so grateful for the love they gave me. I understand it was a great time to be a Chelsea fan, winning the Champions League, winning the FA Cup and the Europa League. 'I was also just so lucky to be there at that time. It was a very important part of my life. ‘In your career you need talent, you need professionalism, you need consistency, but you also need luck to be in the right place at a certain time. I feel that I was at that time at Chelsea. 'I felt very good on the pitch, I felt very confident and I felt very grateful, because I could feel the support of the fans. ‘I felt that ever since I arrived. That pushed me to try to get better and better. Thankfully we could give them the reward that they deserved - trophies, goals and good football!’
news.body_zh: 随着胡安·马塔宣布退役的消息，我们回顾了几年前对西班牙人进行的一次采访，在采访中他反思了他对这家具乐部和这座城市的热爱，这将使他永远感激他在斯坦福桥度过的时光……马塔是西班牙人四重奏中的一员，他们在切尔西建立了持久的友谊。 2011年8月22日，切尔西和瓦伦西亚就这位中场核心离开祖国达成了协议。此后的几年里，他又在曼联、加拉塔萨雷、神户胜利船以及现在的西悉尼流浪者队效力过。他已经成为每个俱乐部球迷的最爱，部分原因是他的表现、个性和创造性的比赛风格，但也因为他拥抱了每个俱乐部各自城市的生活和文化。他在切尔西期间撰写的定期博客同样致力于更新他的足球生涯和探索伦敦的旅行，其中充满了他自己的摄影作品。是的，他是蓝军的一名伟大球员。但更重要的是，他成为了我们中的一员，一个被收养的伦敦人，感受到了俱乐部和这座城市的脉搏。 “我喜欢这样，而且我总是尝试这样做，”他解释道。 “我在土耳其、伊斯坦布尔（一座令人难以置信的城市）和日本也做了同样的事情。我发现了解我所居住的城市周围的环境、文化和历史很重要。 “我非常荣幸有机会住在伦敦、曼彻斯特、伊斯坦布尔、日本和澳大利亚。我正在了解不同的文化、不同的城市氛围，并且我已经尽力去拥抱它们。”毫无疑问，马塔在他的生活中实现了罕见的平衡。你只需看看他职业生涯的成功和长久，在37岁时仍在顶级联赛踢球，就知道他是一位敬业的职业球员。但他也意识到，除了足球之外，还有更多的生活和幸福。当然，这并不意味着他热爱的运动不是他自豪和快乐的重要源泉。对于一个创造过如此多职业生涯新高的人来说，这怎么可能不是，其中最精彩的是他在斯坦福桥的时光。他在切尔西的第一个赛季已经载入史册。 2012年，马塔无法停止胜利。随着 2011/2012 赛季奖杯陆续到来，他的出场次数比任何其他切尔西外场球员都多，而马塔就是这一切的核心。在足总杯半决赛中，他在 5-1 击败对手托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中攻入一球，我们最终赢得了这场比赛。他在欧冠16强对阵那不勒斯的客场比赛中攻入关键进球，帮助我们在斯坦福桥完成了著名的逆转。他为迪迪埃·德罗巴在决赛中扳平比分提供了完美的助攻，帮助我们成为第一支加冕欧洲冠军的伦敦俱乐部。和费尔南多·托雷斯一样，马塔并没有就此结束——两位切尔西西班牙国家队代表都在2012年欧洲杯决赛中攻入一球，帮助球队4-0击败意大利。 “费尔南多和我的处境一样，”胡安若有所思地反思道。 “好的事情是，当你赢球并如此享受它时，有一点似乎赢球就是一切。这就是问题所在。当你不再获胜时，你就会意识到这是多么困难。 “但那是一段令人难以置信的时光，我们在2012年感到非常幸运，能够赢得足总杯，然后是冠军联赛，然后是与西班牙队的欧洲杯，我们都在决赛中进球。”这是令人难以置信的两三个月，可能是我一生中最美好的夏天。 “随着时间的推移，你会意识到这在职业生涯中是多么困难。赢得其中一个奖杯已经很多了，但有机会一起赢得这些奖杯，就像一个梦想。我们正乘着积极的浪潮，良好的足球，以及特别好的结果。这太不可思议了。”胡安谦虚地说，“这太不可思议了”。对于看台上的切尔西球迷来说，更多的时候是“他太不可思议了”。当他们投票选举马塔为俱乐部2011/12赛季年度最佳球员时，他们也说了同样的话，并在接下来的赛季再次投票，当时他的壁炉架上还附有球员评选的年度最佳球员奖。尽管这是马塔第一次在国外生活，但在英格兰安顿下来，无论是场上还是场下，都没有任何问题。据胡安说，这是因为其中一个因素是与另一个因素齐头并进的。当被问及第一次在不同的国家生活有何感受时，他强调说：“我喜欢它。” “我一抵达伦敦，就感受到了巨大的能量。从我刚来的时候起，情况就很积极。 “当然，伦敦是一座伟大的城市。我喜欢在伦敦的生活，了解不同的国家、不同的文化、不同的语言。一个充满机会的城市。 “在球场上，从第一分钟起就表现得非常完美——我记得我的处子秀就进球了。所以这是我生活中的一个巨大变化，离开了西班牙，离开了我生活了四年的瓦伦西亚，但我觉得这是正确的时间，我很高兴我这么做了。 “我的队友很棒，我们有一个很棒的更衣室。以我为例，费尔南多·托雷斯以及队长和领导人——约翰·特里、彼得·切赫、弗兰克·兰帕德。 “他们一开始非常乐于助人，为我可能需要的任何事情提供了帮助。在他们的帮助下，加上我愿意探索伦敦并定居下来，这是一个相当快的适应。”在这些队友中，他很快就成为了一个紧密的西班牙球员社区，为他提供了支持。其中有经验更丰富的费尔南多·托雷斯，他于去年一月从利物浦加盟切尔西，奥里奥尔·罗梅乌在胡安之前几周于2011年8月从巴塞罗那抵达，而塞萨尔·阿斯皮利奎塔将在第二年夏天加入他们。 “这非常重要。首先，拥有费尔南多；事实上，他对于去切尔西的决定非常重要。之前当我有兴趣的时候，他给我打电话，告诉我那里的生活如何，俱乐部如何需要我和教练。 '这让我的决定更容易。我对费尔南多作为一名球员和一个人充满了尊重、钦佩和热爱。他是一个很大的帮助。 “奥里奥尔同时到达，他是我一生中遇到的最好的人之一，不仅仅是在足球领域。能和他在一起，了解这样一位令人惊奇的人物，真是太棒了。我们还是说了很多话。 “这绝对是我在切尔西的积极因素之一，能够更好地了解费尔南多、奥里奥尔和后来到达的阿斯皮。 “我们不仅仅是队友，我们还是朋友。当然，我和费尔南多的关系早在国家队就开始了，但由于我们在切尔西共事的时光，我们成为了亲密的朋友。 “我认为他是我职业生涯中最好的朋友之一。他年纪更大，经验也更丰富。他是一位非常重要的球员；他总是给我和其他人提供建议。他对我们所有人都非常重要，我从他身上学到了很多东西。 “我也已经从国家队、21岁以下青年队和年轻一代中认识了阿斯皮，但我们再次建立了牢固的关系。 “和奥里奥尔一起，我们住在巴特西的同一栋楼里，所以我们大部分时间都一起训练和返回同一辆车。我认识了他出色的家庭，他也认识了我的家庭。 “我们过去常在欧冠之夜一起看足球。我们曾经一起吃晚饭。休息日我们会在伦敦一起制定计划。我们是朋友，我们在一起度过了很多时间。我可以告诉你，和奥里这样的人在一起，你会想和他共度时光，因为如果你在他身边，你的日子会更好！ “我们找到了西班牙餐馆。老布朗普顿路上著名的Cambio de Tercio是我们经常去的地方。奥里奥尔还有一些朋友在该市东部的餐馆工作，从事西班牙导游服务。 “伦敦有很多国籍，还有很多西班牙人，而且我们还有很多游客来观看比赛之类的事情。所以我们从来不觉得无聊！ “我们四个人是非常好的朋友，我很感激我们在一起度过了这么多的时间，但我们在更衣室里也很好地融入了所有的个性、其他文化和国籍的人。 “我认为更衣室里充满活力是赢得欧冠、足总杯和欧联杯冠军的关键。”马塔和阿斯皮利奎塔加盟切尔西时还处于职业生涯的早期。后者后来取得的成就——成为切尔西队长并赢得斯坦福桥的每一件奖杯——还有待书写。然而，马塔证实，当阿斯皮2012年从马赛签约时，他的成功秘诀就已经很明显了。“他已经有一些足球经验，主要是在西班牙和法国联赛，但你已经可以看到他的决心。”我认为阿斯皮是一个因为他的专业精神、他的心态和他的决心而取得今天成就的人。 “除了他作为一名球员的品质之外，对我来说，他的关键特征是他的头脑，你在一开始就已经看到了这一点。 “他遇到了一些麻烦，一开始没有得到他想要的那么多比赛时间，但他非常坚定地等待机会，他得到了他应得的。 “他在切尔西度过了令人难以置信的职业生涯，赢得了很多奖杯，并担任了一段时间的队长。他是俱乐部的传奇人物，他得到了应得的认可，因为他百分百致力于自己的职业生涯。马塔在切尔西不仅与他的队友们保持着良好的关系。毫无疑问，他和蓝军球迷对彼此给予了高度的尊重，这种联系在他 2014 年 1 月离开后很长一段时间内一直持续着。“我仍然从切尔西球迷那里感受到这种感觉。我非常感谢他们给予我的爱。我知道那是作为切尔西球迷的美好时光，赢得了冠军联赛、足总杯和欧罗巴联赛的冠军。 “我当时也很幸运能在那里。这是我生活中非常重要的一部分。 “在你的职业生涯中，你需要天赋，你需要专业精神，你需要一致性，但你也需要运气才能在某个时间处于正确的位置。我感觉当时我就在切尔西。 “我在球场上的感觉非常好，我感到非常自信，我感到非常感激，因为我能感受到球迷的支持。自从我到达以来我就感觉到了。这促使我努力变得越来越好。值得庆幸的是，我们可以给他们应得的奖励——奖杯、进球和精彩的足球！

news.body_en: Information has been confirmed on the loyalty points required by members wishing to access sales for our December trip to Manchester. Chelsea will play Manchester City in the Premier League on Saturday 12 December with a 5:30pm kick-off at the Etihad Stadium. Ticket sales for this match will be as follows: Wednesday 18 November from 10am until 11:30am: Tickets will be sold to members with 40 loyalty points or more who can purchase one ticket per person. Wednesday 18 November from 12pm until 1:30pm: Tickets will be sold to members with 35 loyalty points or more who can purchase one ticket per person. Wednesday 18 November from 2pm until 3.30pm: Tickets will be sold to members with 30 loyalty points or more who can purchase one ticket per person. Wednesday 18 November from 4pm: All remaining members who have yet to purchase can purchase one ticket per person. Tickets will be sold online only. Supporters who require accessible tickets can submit an application form found here during the selling period. Alternatively, supporters, if they are able to do so, can call our Access Team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) to reserve tickets and request further information. Personal assistant tickets can only be allocated using this process. Manchester City offer 14 spaces in Grey Car Park Gate 7 M11 3DL. Please indicate your wish to book one at the time of your ticket request. Spaces will be allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Supporters are required to email access@chelseafc.com providing their car registration and to confirm they are happy for it to be passed on and contacted by Manchester City. Coach travel to the Etihad will be on sale from 10:00am on Tuesday 17 November. Coaches will depart Stamford Bridge at 09:30am and Newport Pagnell at 11:00am and will be priced at £22.50 per person. Please note that all timings are estimated and will be confirmed on your final itinerary sent via email three to five days before travel. Supporters can click here to purchase or call on 0333 230 9115. You should only book travel if you have a valid match ticket. Click for full details on coach bookings, including coach allocation, special requirements, minimum numbers for coaches to run, when card payments will be taken and car park booking at Stamford Bridge when travelling from there by coach. We have received an allocation of 3,065 tickets which includes an allocation of 25 non-ambulant and 25 personal assistant tickets. Ambulant tickets will be taken from the main allocation. The entire allocation for this fixture will be in digital form. This will be clearly marked on the online portal, so supporters can be aware that they are purchasing tickets in this format. Tickets will be sent from Monday 7 December, via email. Supporters who do not receive their tickets should email the ticket office on Friday 11 December no later than 12pm. Please note that away duplicate tickets can only be collected by supporters in the booking. Loyalty points will be awarded for purchasing away tickets. If purchasing on the away ticket exchange, points will remain with the original purchaser and additionally be awarded to the new ticket holder. If using away ticket transfer, points will remain with the original ticket purchaser. Supporters will receive one loyalty point for this match. For the 2026/27 season, away ticket holders will only be able to pass on their ticket to an existing eligible member. The away ticket transfer form, where supporters can provide the name and membership number of the person who will be using the ticket, will be available in the week leading up to the fixture. Away ticket holders will be able to transfer their ticket up to six times per season. Digital and in-person spot checks will be carried out to ensure the correct information has been provided to the club. The form will be active on Wednesday 9 December from 12pm. To access the form please click here. For the 2026/27 season Chelsea FC may, at our discretion, make away match tickets for Premier League matches available to sell and be purchased on the ticket exchange. More information will be provided once the sales process is completed. Away match tickets are not refundable. Tickets for this match are priced as follows: Supporters under 14 are not allowed to enter the stadium without an adult (over 18). Supporters over 14 and under 18 can enter the stadium unaccompanied however they are not allowed to be responsible for another supporter.
