news.title: Internationals: Neto scores as Quenda and Antwi make debuts
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：内托进球，昆达和安特维首次亮相
news.body_en: Pedro Neto went through the full range of emotions with Portugal on a crazy night in Wales, but it was his goal which guaranteed Portugal would finish top of their UEFA Nations League group, on the evening that Geovany Quenda and Genesis Antwi both represented their senior national teams for the first time. Neto started on the left wing for already qualified Portugal and was unlucky to only get his name on the score sheet once in the pouring rain in Cardiff. The visitors had taken an early lead through captain Bruno Fernandes, only to concede twice, when Neto side-footed in the equaliser shortly before half-time, setting them on course for the point they needed to guarantee top spot. The Chelsea man then came agonisingly close to a second by hitting the foot of the post, before Carlos Forbs did get the winner. However, in a match which had been fiercely contested throughout, Neto committed two fouls in the space of three minutes. He was booked for both of them, meaning his match came to an early end. Portugal held on against Wales for the remaining 14 minutes, helped by Quenda, who replaced Fernandes in the closing stages to make his senior international debut. They progress to the Nations League quarter-finals as group winners, with five victories from six games. That was one of two debuts for Chelsea players on Tuesday evening. The other was Academy graduate Antwi – currently impressing on loan at Strasbourg – who came on as a late substitute for Sweden in their 1-1 draw away to Poland. They also finish first in their group, earning promotion to the top tier of the Nations League. Neto and Quenda weren’t the only Blues in action for Portugal on Tuesday, with Academy midfielder Isaac Badu lining up for the country’s Under-18s in a home friendly against the USA earlier in the day. They claimed a 2-1 victory, with all three goals coming in the space of five frantic first-half minutes. Freddy Bernal, Landon Emenalo, Reggie Walsh and Chizaram Ezenwata all started for England Under-19s against Austria in qualification for next year’s European Championship. Walsh found the net with an instant reply after England had conceded early on and Bernal produced a series of strong saves. It wasn’t enough to prevent a 4-1 defeat, although the six points already accumulated were enough for England to progress to the third and final round of qualifying. In the younger age group, Reggie Watson captained England Under-17s to victory alongside fellow Chelsea midfielder Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli, with Josh Henry among the substitutes. They defeated Ukraine 3-0 to claim maximum points from this month’s European Championship qualifying round. Elsewhere, Alfie Osborne captained Scotland Under-19s once again, although they suffered their only defeat of the international window, falling 4-1 to Belgium. Jacob Hall was part of the USA Under-20s side which were beaten 2-1 by Paraguay in a home friendly.
news.body_zh: 佩德罗·内托在威尔士度过了一个疯狂的夜晚，为葡萄牙队经历了各种各样的情绪，但正是他的进球保证了葡萄牙队在欧足联国家联赛小组中名列前茅，而当晚乔瓦尼·昆达和珍尼西斯·安特维都首次代表他们的高级国家队出场。内托在已经晋级的葡萄牙队中担任左翼首发，但不幸的是，在卡迪夫的倾盆大雨中，他的名字只出现在进球表上一次。客队在队长布鲁诺·费尔南德斯的带领下早早取得领先，但在半场结束前不久，内托侧脚扳平比分，但他们却两次失球，这使得他们有望获得确保榜首的位置。随后，这位切尔西球员击中门柱脚，险些获得第二个进球，而卡洛斯·福布斯最终取得了制胜球。然而，在整场比赛的激烈争夺中，内托在三分钟内就两次犯规。他两人都被黄牌警告，这意味着他的比赛提前结束。葡萄牙队在对阵威尔士的比赛中还剩 14 分钟，在昆达的帮助下，昆达在最后阶段替换费尔南德斯上演了他的国家队首秀。他们以小组第一身份晋级国家联赛四分之一决赛，六场比赛取得五场胜利。这是周二晚上切尔西球员的两场首秀之一。另一位是青训球员安特维，目前租借至斯特拉斯堡，表现出色，在瑞典客场1-1战平波兰的比赛中，他在最后时刻替补出场。他们还以小组第一的身份晋级国家联赛顶级联赛。内托和昆达并不是周二唯一代表葡萄牙出战的蓝军，青训营中场球员艾萨克·巴杜在当天早些时候代表该国 U-18 队参加了一场主场对阵美国的友谊赛。他们以 2-1 获胜，所有三个进球都是在上半场疯狂的五分钟内打进的。弗雷迪·伯纳尔 (Freddy Bernal)、兰登·埃梅纳洛 (Landon Emenalo)、雷吉·沃尔什 (Reggie Walsh) 和奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔 (Chizaram Ezenwata) 都为英格兰 19 岁以下青年队首发，对阵奥地利，争夺明年欧洲锦标赛的资格。在英格兰队早早失球后，沃尔什立即破门得分，伯纳尔做出了一系列有力的扑救。尽管已经积累的六分足以让英格兰队晋级预选赛第三轮，也是最后一轮，但这并不足以阻止球队以 4-1 失利。在年轻年龄组中，雷吉·沃森作为英格兰U-17队队长，与切尔西中场球员马赫迪·尼科尔·贾祖利一起取得了胜利，乔什·亨利也在替补席上。他们以3-0击败乌克兰队，获得本月欧洲杯预选赛的最高分。在其他地方，阿尔菲·奥斯本再次担任苏格兰U-19队队长，尽管他们遭遇了国际比赛窗口中的唯一一场失利，以4-1不敌比利时。雅各布·霍尔 (Jacob Hall) 是美国 20 岁以下青年队的一员，他们在主场友谊赛中被巴拉圭 2-1 击败。

news.title: Key talking points from Bompastor and Cuthbert's pre-Paris Saint-Germain press conference
news.title_zh: 邦帕斯托和卡斯伯特巴黎圣日耳曼赛前新闻发布会的关键谈话要点
news.body_en: Head coach Sonia Bompastor and captain Erin Cuthbert spoke to the media at Cobham on Tuesday, before Chelsea host Paris Saint-Germain in the UEFA Women's Champions League, and here are the main talking points from what they had to say. Chelsea head to Plough Lane for Wednesday evening's game in good spirits after beating Manchester City 1-0 last time out, going clear at the top of the Women's Super League table in the process. In Europe, the Blues remain unbeaten and are yet to concede a goal. Despite a 0-0 draw away to Hacken last week, Chelsea are within two points of the leaders in the league phase, but have fallen just outside of the top four and a guaranteed spot in the quarter-finals, without the need for an additional play-off tie. Bompastor: 'We’re feeling great. The Champions League is back. We love this competition and I think right now we are playing every three days. It's really busy, but it's really nice to be able to be back in the Champions League.' Cuthbert: 'Yeah, I feel good. I think, from a player’s perspective, we just want the next game in the Champions League to come, because we dropped points in the last game, and felt like we had a good performance and we just couldn't get the ball in the net. 'So we've had a look at that over the weekend. We've been analysing it. We obviously had a great game at the weekend, but now it's a chance to put things right tomorrow.' Bompastor: 'I think that's important, but these values from us are part of what we want to do when we come on the pitch. We want to come with confidence. We want to come with belief. 'I told my players, what is under our control is for us to be able to put in a good performance on the pitch and make sure we are able to win both the next games. We focus on the next one tomorrow against PSG, but it's under our control. 'I think if we win tomorrow we'll be again in a good position. So we are confident and we have the belief that we have enough quality to still finish in the top four in this competition.' Bompastor: 'I think it's probably not the right time for us to assess our season so far, in terms of we still have two games left in this block. We just want to continue with the quality we have shown on the pitch from the beginning of the season. 'We know who we are as a team, what we want to achieve together. We always have the right balance between having confidence, because we know the quality we have in the squad, but also being humble, because it's so early in the season and we haven’t achieved anything yet.' Cuthbert: 'Just what Sonia said, I'm very much of the opinion that we've won nothing yet. There are no trophies on the table yet. I think the only thing that has been really positive is we've put ourselves in a good position, and that's all it is. 'It's now how do we then look forward and try to win our remaining games in the Champions League to put ourselves in a good position. Obviously it's great to be back at the top of the WSL table, but the league is not won or lost based on the game on Saturday.' Bompastor: 'I always say that when you are strong defensively, it allows you to go really far in every competition you are competing in. If you want to win trophies, you need to make sure you have that and you are able to score goals. 'So right now, the defensive aspects have been something really good for us. The whole team is putting a lot of effort on the pitch to protect the goal. As a mentality in the team, we don't want to concede a goal. That's why it's important for everyone to make the efforts on the pitch, and I'm really pleased with everyone's contribution to that. 'It gives the team the confidence we need. We know right now most of the things we are doing in terms of the defensive aspects, we are doing them well individually, but as a team as well. So I think it goes with the players having clarity on what they need to do on the pitch, but also being on the same page to do those things in the right moments.' Bompastor: 'It's really good news for her. We know her really well. We decided to loan her to Nottingham Forest to get minutes on the pitch. Every week I'm getting the reports from her performances and I know she's doing well over there. So it's credit to her, to all the hard work she has put in on the pitch, and it will be an amazing experience for her as well.'
news.body_zh: 周二，在切尔西在欧洲女子冠军联赛中主场迎战巴黎圣日耳曼队之前，主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯托和队长艾琳·库斯伯特在科巴姆接受了媒体采访，以下是他们所说的主要谈话要点。切尔西在上一场比赛以 1-0 击败曼城后，精神抖擞地前往普劳巷参加周三晚上的比赛，在此过程中在女超联赛积分榜上遥遥领先。在欧洲，蓝军保持不败且尚未失球。尽管上周客场0-0战平哈肯，切尔西在联赛阶段与领头羊的差距只有两分，但已经跌落到前四名之外，并且已经保证了四分之一决赛的席位，不需要额外的附加赛。 Bompastor：“我们感觉很棒。冠军联赛回来了。我们喜欢这项比赛，我想现在我们每三天就比赛一次。这真的很忙，但能够重返冠军联赛真是太好了。”卡斯伯特：“是的，我感觉很好。我认为，从球员的角度来看，我们只是希望欧冠的下一场比赛能够到来，因为我们在上一场比赛中丢了分，感觉我们表现不错，只是无法将球射入球网。 “所以我们周末对此进行了研究。我们一直在分析它。显然，我们周末踢了一场精彩的比赛，但现在是明天改正错误的机会。”庞帕斯特：“我认为这很重要，但我们的这些价值观是我们上场时想要做的事情的一部分。我们希望充满信心地前来。我们想要带着信念而来。 “我告诉我的球员，我们能控制的是我们能够在球场上表现出色，并确保我们能够赢得接下来的两场比赛。我们关注明天对阵巴黎圣日耳曼的下一场比赛，但一切都在我们的掌控之中。 “我认为如果我们明天获胜，我们将再次处于有利位置。所以我们有信心，我们相信我们有足够的实力在这场比赛中仍然进入前四名。” Bompastor：“我认为到目前为止我们可能还不是评估赛季的合适时机，因为我们还剩下两场比赛。”我们只是想继续保持赛季初在球场上表现出的品质。 “我们知道我们作为一个团队是谁，我们想要共同实现什么。我们总是在充满信心和谦虚之间取得适当的平衡，因为我们知道球队的实力，因为现在还处于赛季初期，我们还没有取得任何成就。”卡斯伯特：“正如索尼娅所说，我非常认为我们还没有赢得任何胜利。桌子上还没有奖杯。我认为唯一真正积极的事情是我们把自己置于一个有利的位置，仅此而已。 “现在的问题是我们如何展望未来并努力赢得冠军联赛剩余的比赛，以使自己处于有利的位置。显然，回到 WSL 积分榜榜首真是太好了，但联赛的输赢并不取决于周六的比赛。庞帕斯特：“我总是说，当你的防守很强时，它会让你在参加的每场比赛中走得更远。如果你想赢得奖杯，你需要确保你拥有这一点并且能够进球。 “所以现在，防守方面对我们来说非常有利。整个球队都在场上付出很大的努力来保护球门。作为球队的一种心态，我们不想丢球。这就是为什么每个人在球场上做出努力都很重要，我对每个人为此做出的贡献感到非常高兴。 “这给了球队我们所需要的信心。我们知道现在我们在防守方面所做的大部分事情，我们个人做得很好，但作为一个团队也做得很好。因此，我认为球员们必须清楚自己在球场上需要做什么，同时也要在正确的时刻达成一致，做到这些事情。” Bompastor：“这对她来说确实是个好消息。我们非常了解她。我们决定将她租借到诺丁汉森林以获得上场时间。每周我都会收到她的表演报告，我知道她在那里表现得很好。所以这是她的功劳，归功于她在球场上付出的所有努力，这对她来说也将是一次奇妙的经历。”

news.title: Bompastor updates on Buchanan, Dragoni, Malard and Matsukubo ahead of PSG
news.title_zh: 博姆帕斯托在巴黎圣日耳曼之前更新了布坎南、德拉格尼、马拉德和松久保的情况
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor revealed that she will be without a striker for Wednesday’s UEFA Women’s Champions League tie with Paris Saint-Germain but has gained two players who have recovered from injury, while providing the latest on the returns of several players who have been missing recently. At either end of the pitch for Chelsea, centre-forward Melvine Malard and centre-back Kadeisha Buchanan both had to be replaced in the first half of Saturday’s 1-0 win over Manchester City, which sent the Blues top of the Women’s Super League table. It was a heavy cost for an important victory, and Bompastor confirmed that Malard will be ruled out by the issue she suffered at Stamford Bridge. ‘Melvine picked up an injury in the last game against Man City so she won’t be available for the two games left during this block,’ said the Blues head coach in her pre-match press conference ahead of the meeting with PSG. ‘So we will assess her during the international break and see where she is, but she picked up an injury in her hamstring. ‘I think we need to assess her in ten days, so probably we will have a better picture during the international break to see exactly how long she will be out.’ However, there was better news on Buchanan, as well as the potential imminent returns to the pitch of summer signings Giulia Dragoni and Manaka Matsukubo, who both missed Saturday’s game. ‘Kadeisha is fine after the weekend, she is available for the game tomorrow. She could train normally today,’ Bompastor continued. ‘Giulia is back in the squad. Manaka won’t be in the squad tomorrow, but she is not far from being in the group and training with us again.’ Bompastor had previously confirmed that neither Lauren James nor Naomi Girma would be able to return in time for Wednesday’s Champions League meeting with Paris Saint-Germain at Plough Lane, but provided an update on their progress. ‘As I said on Melvine, Lauren won’t be available for the next two games and we’ll have to assess her again during the international break to see exactly about the timeline. ‘LJ is doing well. I think for this block she won’t be available, but we will update everyone after the international break about how long she will take to come back again. ‘Naomi is still rehabbing. She is progressing well. She will stay with us during the international break and the plan is for her to be back probably after the international break.’
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特透露，周三与巴黎圣日耳曼队的欧洲女足冠军联赛比赛中，她将缺席前锋，但她已经获得了两名从伤病中恢复的球员，同时提供了最近缺席的几名球员的最新回归情况。在周六1-0战胜曼城的比赛中，切尔西在球场两端的中锋梅尔文·马拉德和中后卫卡德伊沙·布坎南都被替换下场，这场比赛让蓝军在女超联赛积分榜上名列前茅。对于一场重要的胜利来说，这是一个沉重的代价，邦帕斯托证实，马拉德将因她在斯坦福桥遭遇的问题而被排除在外。 “梅尔文在上一场对阵曼城的比赛中受伤，因此她将无法参加本赛季剩下的两场比赛，”蓝军主教练在与巴黎圣日耳曼会面之前的赛前新闻发布会上说道。 “所以我们会在国际比赛日期间对她进行评估，看看她的情况，但她的腿筋受伤了。 “我认为我们需要在十天内对她进行评估，所以我们可能会在国际比赛日期间有更好的了解，看看她到底会缺席多久。”然而，关于布坎南的消息有更好的消息，以及夏季新援朱莉娅·德拉戈尼和松久保真中可能即将重返赛场，他们都缺席了周六的比赛。 “周末后卡黛莎状态很好，她可以参加明天的比赛。她今天可以正常训练，”邦帕斯特继续说道。 “朱莉娅回到了球队。马纳卡明天不会进入大名单，但她距离再次加入球队并与我们一起训练已经不远了。”邦帕斯特此前曾证实劳伦·詹姆斯和内奥米·吉尔玛都无法及时返回参加周三在普洛巷与巴黎圣日耳曼队进行的冠军联赛比赛，但提供了他们的最新进展情况。 “正如我在《梅尔文》中所说，劳伦将无法参加接下来的两场比赛，我们必须在国际比赛日期间再次评估她，以了解确切的时间表。 ‘LJ 做得很好。我认为在这个时段她将无法上场，但我们会在国际比赛日结束后向大家通报她需要多长时间才能再次回归。 “内奥米仍在康复中。她进展顺利。她将在国际比赛日期间和我们在一起，计划是她可能在国际比赛日后回来。

news.title: Sandy Baltimore grateful for Paris education but not looking back
news.title_zh: 桑迪·巴尔的摩感谢巴黎的教育，但没有回头
news.body_en: Sandy Baltimore discussed how Paris and Paris Saint-Germain helped shape her both as a footballer and a person, but is only looking to the future with Chelsea now as she prepares to face her former club in west London. Chelsea Women continue our unbeaten UEFA Women’s Champions League campaign on Wednesday evening when we host Paris Saint-Germain at Plough Lane, looking to register our third win. For Baltimore, it is a fixture which will have added significance. She is preparing to line up against Paris Saint-Germain as an opponent for the first time, having won the league and three cups with PSG, as well as reaching the Champions League final in 2017. The French international was born and raised in the Parisian suburbs and began her professional career with the club, spending nine years representing Paris Saint-Germain before moving to England to join Chelsea in 2024. ‘I grew up in Paris, I was born there, so I grew up with PSG. They were my first team and it was good over there,’ Baltimore tells us ahead of Wednesday’s Champions League showdown. ‘I learned a lot of things about football and me personally in Paris, about women, about growing up, about developing as a person. I started football in school with the boys, just playing football outside with some friends, just chill. ‘I was 15 years old when I joined PSG, I was with the Under-19s straight away. Then after I trained with the Under-19s, I joined the first team at 16 or 17. ‘When you want to grow up more, it was good I joined PSG when I was younger. Then after, you just work every day, you learn, because they are also good players there. So I learned a lot. ‘It was good when we won the league. I was so happy because it was my first trophy, because I’m from Paris and I played for PSG, and you have also your family, your friends. You have a lot of things, so you feel good after that.’ That meant it was a big step for Baltimore when she took the chance to leave Paris and PSG behind for London and Chelsea, moving away from her home city and club for the first time. Although there have been challenges along the way, she insists it was not a difficult switch to make. ‘Honestly, at the beginning for me it wasn't difficult, because it was my objective to grow, to change, to take another opportunity to progress in my career and as a woman. So I was happy to come here. ‘The leagues in England and France are different, especially the intensity and physicality, so I think I learn a lot because Chelsea is a good team, we have good players. So you work every day and then I progress also. It's good. ‘This season, at the beginning, I didn't play too much. When you are a player, you're a little bit frustrated to not play, but I have a big mentality and I also work with a mentality coach, so he helped me a lot. ‘Also, I don't talk too much, but I work hard every day. I learn and I just keep going because I don't want to give up. I never give up. So for me, it's important to keep going, go forward and then just show your quality on the pitch.’ Now, her focus is fully on the Blues and gaining another important three points in this season’s Champions League on Wednesday, which could potentially move us into first place in the standings, if results elsewhere go our way. Chelsea head into the match on a high, too, after going clear at the top of the Women’s Super League table with a 1-0 win over Manchester City at the weekend, courtesy of Baltimore’s stunning strike in first-half added time. ‘It was important because we know how the table looks, it’s really tight,’ she added. ‘So it was important for us to win this game because every week it's hard to win. ‘But we did and we were so happy. We stuck together and I scored and I tried to help the team, so I was happy. I think we go forward with more confidence, because last week against Man City we played well. ‘But I think it's different, because the Champions League is the Champions League. Everyone wants to win that. I think every team looks different when it’s the Champions League, so you have to prepare for that and you’ve got to be on your best game.’
news.body_zh: 桑迪·巴尔的摩讨论了巴黎和巴黎圣日耳曼如何帮助塑造她作为一名足球运动员和一个人，但她现在只展望切尔西的未来，因为她准备在伦敦西部面对她的前俱乐部。周三晚上，切尔西女足将在普洛巷迎战巴黎圣日耳曼队，继续保持不败的欧洲女子冠军联赛战绩，希望获得第三场胜利。对于巴尔的摩来说，这是一场意义非凡的比赛。她正在准备首次作为对手对阵巴黎圣日耳曼，她随巴黎圣日耳曼赢得了联赛冠军和三座杯赛冠军，并在 2017 年打进了欧洲冠军联赛决赛。这位法国国脚在巴黎郊区出生和长大，在俱乐部开始了她的职业生涯，代表巴黎圣日耳曼效力了九年，然后于 2024 年前往英格兰加盟切尔西。他们是我的第一支球队，那里的情况很好，”巴尔的摩在周三的冠军联赛对决之前告诉我们。 “我在巴黎学到了很多关于足球和我个人的东西，关于女性，关于成长，关于作为一个人的发展。我在学校和孩子们一起开始踢足球，只是和一些朋友在外面踢足球，放松一下。 “当我加入巴黎圣日耳曼队时，我才 15 岁，我立即就加入了 U-19 队。然后，在我与U-19队一起训练后，我在16或17岁的时候加入了一线队。‘当你想要更多成长时，我在年轻时加入巴黎圣日耳曼是件好事。然后，你每天都在工作、学习，因为他们也是那里的优秀球员。所以我学到了很多。 “当我们赢得联赛冠军时，感觉很好。我很高兴，因为这是我的第一座奖杯，因为我来自巴黎，我为巴黎圣日耳曼效力，而且你还有你的家人、你的朋友。你拥有很多东西，所以在那之后你感觉很好。”这意味着当巴尔的摩抓住机会离开巴黎和巴黎圣日耳曼前往伦敦和切尔西时，这对巴尔的摩来说是一大步，第一次离开她的家乡城市和俱乐部。尽管一路上遇到了挑战，但她坚持认为这并不是一个困难的转变。 “老实说，一开始对我来说并不困难，因为我的目标是成长、改变、抓住另一个机会在我的职业生涯和作为一名女性方面取得进步。所以我很高兴来到这里。 “英格兰和法国的联赛不同，尤其是强度和身体素质，所以我认为我学到了很多东西，因为切尔西是一支优秀的球队，我们有优秀的球员。所以你每天工作，然后我也进步。很好。 “这个赛季一开始，我并没有打太多比赛。当你是一名球员时，你会因为不能上场而感到有点沮丧，但我有一个很大的心态，而且我也和一位心态教练一起工作，所以他给了我很多帮助。 ‘还有，我话不多，但我每天都在努力工作。我学习并继续前进，因为我不想放弃。我从不放弃。所以对我来说，继续前进、前进，然后在球场上展示你的实力很重要。”现在，她的注意力完全集中在蓝军身上，并在周三的本赛季冠军联赛中再获得重要的三分，如果其他地方的结果对我们有利的话，这可能会让我们在积分榜上排名第一。周末，凭借巴尔的摩在上半场补时阶段的惊人进球，切尔西以 1-0 战胜曼城，在女足超级联赛积分榜上遥遥领先，切尔西也以高昂的战绩进入了这场比赛。 “这很重要，因为我们知道桌子的样子，它真的很紧，”她补充道。 “所以赢得这场比赛对我们来说很重要，因为每周都很难获胜。 “但我们做到了，而且我们很高兴。我们团结在一起，我进球了，我努力帮助球队，所以我很高兴。我认为我们会更有信心前进，因为上周对阵曼城我们踢得很好。 “但我认为这是不同的，因为冠军联赛就是冠军联赛。每个人都想赢得那场胜利。我认为在欧冠联赛中，每支球队看起来都会有所不同，所以你必须为此做好准备，并且必须打出最好的比赛。”

news.title: Internationals: Estevao nets and assists in big Brazil win
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：埃斯特沃进球并助攻巴西队大胜
news.body_en: Estevao Willian scored for Brazil and registered two assists as they thrashed Singapore 7-0 in a friendly on Tuesday. Vinicius Junior had already netted a brace when Estevao unselfishly teed him up in the 21st minute so the Real Madrid striker could complete an early hat-trick. The Chelsea attacker then set up Endrick to extend Brazil's advantage, and had a goal of his own ruled out for a foul in the build-up shortly before the break. Estevao did then get in on the act early in the second half, firing home with the aid of a deflection from a half-cleared free-kick. Estevao, who started on the right side of Brazil's attack, was replaced on 70 minutes to a standing ovation inside the National Stadium in Singapore. He now has seven international goals to his name in 16 caps.
news.body_zh: 在周二的一场友谊赛中，埃斯特沃·威廉为巴西队攻入一球并送出两次助攻，帮助巴西队以 7-0 击败新加坡队。第21分钟，埃斯特沃无私地为维尼休斯·儒尼奥送上梅开二度，让这位皇马前锋提前上演了帽子戏法。切尔西前锋随后传球给恩德里克，扩大了巴西队的优势，但他自己的进球却因在中场休息前不久犯规而被取消。下半场一开始，埃斯特沃就开始发挥作用，借助半解围的任意球偏转射门得分。埃斯特沃在巴西进攻的右侧首发，第 70 分钟被换下，新加坡国家体育场内全场起立鼓掌。他目前在 16 场国家队比赛中攻入 7 粒进球。

news.title: Dramatic Palmer strike voted your favourite late Chelsea winner!
news.title_zh: 戏剧性的帕尔默进球被评选为你最喜欢的已故切尔西冠军！
news.body_en: Cole Palmer’s 101st-minute goal against Manchester United in 2024 has been voted by Blues fans on the Chelsea Official App as their favourite late winner scored at Stamford Bridge in the Premier League. It was two current members of our squad vying for the crown, which began with our quarter-final vote last week, as Palmer took on Estevao Willian’s late strike against Liverpool a year ago. And it was Palmer who emerged victorious, receiving 62 per cent of the votes cast on the Chelsea Official App. The attacker had only just equalised from the penalty spot - making it 3-3 - when he collected a short corner and fired a shot goalwards that took a small deflection on its way into the back of the Matthew Harding net. It sparked absolute pandemonium in the stands and on the pitch as a dramatic three points was won when it looked like we would leave with nothing. The second-latest winning goal in Premier League history is a worthy winner of the award. Congratulations, Cole!
news.body_zh: 科尔·帕尔默在 2024 年对阵曼联的第 101 分钟进球被切尔西官方应用程序上的蓝军球迷票选为他们最喜欢的英超联赛斯坦福桥比赛最后时刻的制胜进球。我们队中的两名现役球员正在争夺冠军，这一切从上周四分之一决赛的投票开始，帕尔默在一年前对阵利物浦的比赛中，帕尔默接替了埃斯特沃·威廉在最后时刻的进球。帕尔默最终获胜，在切尔西官方应用程序上获得了 62% 的选票。这名攻击手刚刚在点球点扳平比分，比分是 3-3，此时他接到一个短角球，向球门射门，球稍稍偏转，射入马修·哈丁的球网。这在看台上和球场上引发了绝对的混乱，当我们看起来将一无所获时，我们赢得了戏剧性的三分。英超联赛历史上第二晚的致胜进球当之无愧地获得了该奖项。恭喜，科尔！

news.title: Squad debutant among six Blues called up by England Women
news.title_zh: 英格兰女足征召的六名蓝军球员中首次亮相
news.body_en: Chelsea Women will be represented by no fewer than six players in the England Women squad, including a first call-up for Academy graduate Katie Cox. The Lionesses face Ukraine in a two-legged qualifying play-off for the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup, with those matches to be played on 2 and 5 December. Hannah Hampton, Lucy Bronze, Keira Walsh and Lexi Potter - who made her own senior international debut during the last window - all retain their places in Sarina Wiegman's squad, while striker Aggie Beever-Jones is recalled to the group. Following Potter's first call-up in October, now it is the turn of another homegrown Blue, Cox, who has impressed on loan at Nottingham Forest this season. Having represented her country through the age groups from Under-16s to Under-23s, the young goalkeeper has now been named in the senior squad for the first time. Having already recorded a resounding 8-1 aggregate win over Greece in the first round of the play-offs, England would book their place in Brazil for next summer's World Cup with another victory over Ukraine.
news.body_zh: 切尔西女足英格兰女足阵容中将有不少于六名球员，其中包括首次征召的青训毕业生凯蒂·考克斯。母狮队将在 2027 年国际足联女足世界杯预选赛两回合附加赛中对阵乌克兰，比赛将于 12 月 2 日至 5 日举行。汉娜·汉普顿、露西·布朗兹、凯拉·沃尔什和莱克西·波特——在上个转会窗口期间完成了自己的成年国家队首秀——都保留了萨琳娜·维格曼队中的位置，而前锋阿吉·比弗-琼斯则被召回。继十月份波特首次征召入队后，现在轮到另一位本土蓝军考克斯了，他本赛季被租借到诺丁汉森林队，给人留下了深刻的印象。这位年轻门将代表国家参加了从 16 岁以下到 23 岁以下年龄段的比赛，现在首次入选成年队。英格兰队已经在附加赛首轮以总比分8-1大胜希腊队，如果再战胜乌克兰队，他们将获得明年夏天世界杯的参赛资格。

news.title: Flying full-back your Chelsea Women Player of the Month
news.title_zh: 飞翔的边后卫是你的切尔西本月最佳女球员
news.body_en: Chelsea Women completed a brilliant October with a 100 per cent record and supporters on the Chelsea Official App have chosen their standout performer. The Blues triumphed in all four of our matches across all competitions last month, with a trio of London derby wins against West Ham United, Tottenham Hotspur and Crystal Palace in the Women's Super League combined with a 2-0 victory over Roma at home in the UEFA Women's Champions League. Ellie Carpenter's form across those four fixtures earned her 44 per cent of the fans' votes on the Chelsea Official App to seal her status as our October Player of the Month. The Australian international started all our WSL games, finding the net twice in the big win over Spurs, before coming off the bench to score the opening goal against Roma. Lauren James wasn't far behind, taking 34 per cent of the votes in the poll, ahead of third-placed Melvine Malard on 12 per cent. There is little time for Carpenter and her team-mates to reflect, though, with the Blues' attention now firmly fixed on our next game against Paris Saint-Germain in the Champions League on Wednesday evening, before returning to WSL duties with an away trip to Liverpool on Saturday.
news.body_zh: 切尔西女足以 100% 的成绩结束了辉煌的 10 月，切尔西官方应用程序上的支持者选出了她们的杰出表现者。上个月，蓝军在各项赛事的全部四场比赛中均取得胜利，其中在女超联赛中三场伦敦德比战中战胜了西汉姆联队、托特纳姆热刺队和水晶宫队，并在女足冠军联赛中主场2-0战胜了罗马队。艾莉·卡彭特在这四场比赛中的表现为她在切尔西官方应用程序上赢得了 44% 的球迷投票，从而确立了她作为我们十月月度最佳球员的地位。这位澳大利亚国脚在我们所有的WSL比赛中首发出场，在大胜热刺的比赛中两次进球，然后在对阵罗马的比赛中替补出场打进首球。劳伦·詹姆斯 (Lauren James) 也不甘落后，在民意调查中获得了 34% 的选票，领先于排名第三的梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard)，得票率为 12%。不过，卡彭特和她的队友们几乎没有时间反思，蓝军的注意力现在牢牢地集中在周三晚上对阵巴黎圣日耳曼的下一场欧冠比赛上，然后在周六客场对阵利物浦，回到女超级联赛的职责。

news.title: Internationals: Jashayde Greenwood nets for England Under-18s
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：贾沙伊德·格林伍德为英格兰 18 岁以下青年队进球
news.body_en: A number of Chelsea youngsters were in international action during the latest break, with representatives featuring for both England Under-18s and Under-20s, as well as Portugal Under-20s. England Under-18s concluded their trio of friendlies during this window with a narrow 2-1 defeat to Switzerland. Gabriel Sambou and Jashayde Greenwood started for the Young Lions, with Greenwood scoring England's only goal of the game. England Under-20s were victorious in their match against Portugal, meanwhile. Jesse Derry started the 2-1 win, while Shim Mheuka and Olutayo Subuloye were on the bench. The former came on in the 63rd minute. Cobham Next Gen’s Leo Cardoso also featured in that game, introduced in the 79th minute for Portugal Under-20s. As the international break draws to a close, several young Chelsea players will be taking part in their final national team matches of 2026 on Tuesday, with as many as ten Blues in action. We will keep you updated as to how they get on.
news.body_zh: 一些切尔西年轻球员在最近的休息时间参加了国际比赛，其中包括代表英格兰 18 岁以下和 20 岁以下以及葡萄牙 20 岁以下的球员。英格兰U-18队在本窗口期的三场友谊赛以1-2险胜瑞士队结束。加布里埃尔·桑布和贾沙伊德·格林伍德为幼狮队首发，格林伍德打进了英格兰队本场比赛的唯一进球。与此同时，英格兰20岁以下青年队在对阵葡萄牙的比赛中取得了胜利。杰西·德里 (Jesse Derry) 在 2-1 获胜的比赛中首发，而希姆·姆赫卡 (Shim Mheuka) 和奥鲁塔约·苏布洛耶 (Olutayo Subuloye) 则坐在替补席上。前者在第63分钟上场。科巴姆下一代队的利奥·卡多佐也在这场比赛中出场，他是在第 79 分钟为葡萄牙 20 岁以下青年队出场的。随着国际比赛日接近尾声，几名年轻的切尔西球员将于周二参加他们 2026 年最后的国家队比赛，蓝军将有多达 10 名球员参加比赛。我们将随时向您通报他们的进展情况。
